description:
Designation: Manager


Location: India Karnataka Bangalore \- Sanjana Plaza


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------


Job Purpose


To ensure smooth execution of HR processes \& systems within the defined process \& TAT resulting in delighted, engaged and productive employees across the assigned region


Job Context \& Major Challenges


Job Context: To ensure smooth execution of HR processes \& systems within the defined process \& TAT resulting in delighted, engaged and productive employees across the assigned region  

  

Job Challenges: To institutionalize all HR practices and to create an engaged workforce by ensuring a performance oriented culture and to ensure HR delivers as a business partner in respective regions.


Key Result Areas

  

**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**  


KRA1 Meet manpower requirement and provide all HR administrative support to new joinees as well as existing employees at the regions. RECRUITMENT:  

  

1\. Facilitate manpower hiring across the region is within Budget and as per approved manpower plan  

2\. Source all positions upto Manager level within TAT  

3\. Ensure quality of hire within the specified parameter  

4\. Close all critical positions in shortest possible time within the hiring budget  

5\. Ensure recruitments are done with an optimum sourcing mix to maintain cost within budget.  

6\. Ensure compensation alignment for all recruitments (within given bands) during the hiring process  


KRA2 Meet manpower requirement and provide all HR administrative support to new joinees as well as existing employees at the regions. HR OPERATIONS:  

  

1\. Provide functional direction \& ensure smooth \& uniform delivery of HR Ops issues pertaining to joining, compensation, exits etc across branches, regions \& verticals  

2\. Coordinate and resolve employee query with contact points in HR/ Payroll  

3\. Provide support/assistance for smooth transition to the shared services model and act as the first point of escalation for unresolved queries.  

  

ATTRITION MANAGEMENT:  

  

1\. Conduct structured exit interview for all exits upto Manager level and record the same.  

2\. Analyse attrition in the region and identify key reasons contributing maximum to the attrition numbers  

3\. Devise mechanisms, steps \& local initiatives (like skip levels, open house sessions etc) to address employee concerns \& arrest the factors contributing most to the attrition bucket.  

4\. Partner with BM/BH in counselling session of employees during branch visits in case of disciplinary/ attitudinal issues  


KRA3 Execute all OD initiatives \& other initiatives of corporate HR to achieve a highly engaged workforce at the zones. OD INTERVENTIONS/ INITIATIVES:  

  

1\. Conduct various employee engagement/fun initiatives/activities across the region from time to time  

2\. Emphasise on employee referral policy and encourage employees for enhanced participation  

3\. Guide BMs with the process of handling cases of indiscipline, abscondance, PIP \& other ER issues  

4\. Drive initiatives like Poornata, OHS action planning, Goal setting, Q12 etc. from time to time  

5\. Conduct structured induction program for all new joinees, immediately on joining.  


KRA4 Help the region in creating an environment of trust and to satisfactorily \& speedily resolution of any ER issues in the region. HR NORMS:  

  

1\. Ensure adherence to norms as per checklist (statutory and audit) while conducting branch visits.  

2\. Ensure escalation of non\-adherence cases and adopting measures for fast resolution.  

3\. Educate sales and support staff by addressing on various HR norms during branch visits in cases of non\-adherence.  

  

HANDLING ER ISSUES:  

  

1\. Ensure Code of conduct awareness among the employees in the region  

2\. Independently investigate any reported breach and to recommend course of action to be taken  

3\. Speedy and effective investigation of all cases in the region sent by alert and forward detailed report to the whistle blower committee.  

4\. Ensure spelling out SOPs on people practice in various communication forums (Meetings/workshops) creating a harmonious relation in the region.  


KRA5 Create a Learning environment in the assigned region. LEARNING:  

  

To receive feedback from Sales/Operations team identifying the learning requirements and prepare a PDP (Performance Development Planning) matrix facilitating online training/ workshop  

  

SELF DEVELOPMENT \-  

  

1\. Ensure discussion with immediate supervisor on areas of improvement and focus on development needs, if any  

2\. Ensure self learning through training programs, including participation in online programs from Adityadisha

title: P&C Business Partner (Bangalore candidates only)
description:
**Work Timings:** **5:30 PM to 2:30 AM**

**What You'll Do**

A successful People \& Culture Business Partner will partner with business leaders, managers, and employees to drive core People \& Culture processes, strengthen employee engagement, support employee lifecycle activities, and ensure consistent application of people practices aligned to business needs and organizational policies.


**Responsibilities**

**Policy Awareness \& Guidance** – Drive awareness and understanding of People \& Culture policies and processes among employees and managers. Provide timely guidance to ensure adherence, consistency, and clarity across the organization. Regularly support review and updates of internal SOPs and policy documents.


* **Employee Engagement \& Connects** – Conduct regular employee connects, manager interactions, and leadership sessions to understand employee concerns and improve engagement. Plan and execute engagement activities in collaboration with the People \& Culture team to build a positive work environment.
* **Performance Management** – Support performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, and calibration. Guide managers on process expectations and best practices to ensure fairness, clarity, and timely completion of performance cycles.
* **Rewards \& Recognition** – Drive reward and recognition initiatives and support optimal utilization of approved budgets. Promote peer\-to\-peer recognition through available tools and programs to strengthen a culture of appreciation.
* **Employee Relations \& Grievance Handling** – Manage employee grievances and workplace concerns with sensitivity, confidentiality, and professionalism. Provide practical guidance and counselling support to employees and managers to help resolve issues effectively.
* **Exit Management** – Support employees and managers through exit processes, ensuring smooth, timely, and compliant completion of exit formalities while maintaining a positive employee experience.
* **Compliance \& Training** – Drive completion of mandatory compliance trainings within defined timelines. Partner with business teams to support adherence to statutory, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
* **Reporting** – Maintain accurate organization structures, span of control data, and People \& Culture documentation. Prepare reports, trackers, and presentations for leadership and business reviews as required.
* **Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement** – Facilitate leadership connects and People \& Culture process or tool orientations for business leaders. Partner with stakeholders to align People \& Culture initiatives with business priorities.
* **Early Warning** **\& Risk Identification** –Support proactive identification of risks related to attrition, engagement, performance, and employee concerns. Work with managers to identify corrective actions and follow through on agreed plans.
* **New Hire Integration** – Conduct new employee orientation sessions and new hire connects to ensure smooth onboarding, integration, and early engagement within the organization.
* **Internal Talent Movement** – Manage Internal Job Posting processes for key roles, ensuring a transparent, timely, and business\-aligned process for internal talent movement.

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**
========================================

* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or a related field preferred.
* 4 to 6 years of total work experience, including relevant HR Business Partner or People \& Culture Business Partner exposure.
* Strong understanding of People \& Culture processes including employee relations, employee engagement, performance management, onboarding, exits, and policy guidance.
* Good communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with employees, managers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with confidentiality, professionalism, and sound judgement.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

**What You May Need to be Successful:**

* Experience handling employee lifecycle processes in a dynamic business environment.
* Demonstrated success in supporting engagement initiatives, compliance trainings, employee relations matters, and performance management cycles.
* Collaborative approach with strong stakeholder management and follow\-through skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR or People \& Culture systems.
* Ability to work predominantly office\-based schedules, including night shift requirements, where applicable to the business.

title: HR Intern
description:
**HR Intern**

**Experience**

* Fresher to 6 months of experience
* Students pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field are encouraged to apply.

**Job Type**

* Internship (Full\-Time)

**Working Days**

* Monday to Friday

**Working Hours**

* 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM

**Stipend**

* As per company policy

**Job Location**

* Office\-Based

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic HR Intern to support our Human Resources department in day\-to\-day operations. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a willingness to learn, and a keen interest in recruitment, employee engagement, and HR operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

* Post job openings on job portals and social media platforms.
* Source candidates through various recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule interviews with hiring managers.
* Coordinate interview rounds and maintain interview schedules.
* Conduct initial HR screening calls.
* Follow up with candidates regarding interview status.

**Employee Onboarding**

* Prepare offer letters and joining documents.
* Collect and verify employee documentation.
* Assist in employee onboarding and orientation.
* Maintain employee records and personnel files.

**HR Operations**

* Update and maintain employee databases.
* Maintain attendance and leave records.
* Support payroll documentation.
* Prepare HR reports and MIS.
* Ensure employee files are organized and updated.

**Employee Engagement**

* Assist in organizing employee engagement activities.
* Support birthday, festival, and team events.
* Collect employee feedback and maintain engagement records.

**Documentation \& Compliance**

* Prepare HR letters, certificates, and employment documents.
* Ensure confidentiality of employee information.
* Maintain compliance\-related documentation.

**Administrative Support**

* Coordinate with different departments for manpower requirements.
* Manage HR emails and communications.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR reports.
* Perform other HR and administrative tasks assigned by the reporting manager.

**Required Skills**

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and Google Sheets.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to multitask and meet deadlines.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Good interpersonal and coordination skills.
* Professional behavior and confidentiality.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (completed or pursuing) in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of recruitment processes and HR practices.
* Familiarity with job portals and MS Office is an added advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of candidates sourced and screened.
* Interview scheduling accuracy.
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio.
* Employee documentation completion rate.
* Timely maintenance of HR records.
* Recruitment turnaround time.
* Daily HR activity reporting.
* Attendance and data accuracy.

**What You'll Learn**

* End\-to\-end recruitment process.
* HR operations and documentation.
* Employee onboarding and engagement.
* HRMS and recruitment tools.
* Communication and coordination skills.
* Corporate HR practices and compliance.

**Growth Opportunity**

Successful interns may be offered a full\-time position as an **HR Executive** based on performance, discipline, and business requirements.

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
HR Executive / HR Manager

**Company:** IIT Planet  
**Industry:** Education / IIT\-JEE Preparation  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** \[Insert location]  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Salary:** \[Insert salary range]

Job Summary

IIT Planet is looking for an experienced and hands\-on HR professional to independently manage the complete employee lifecycle. The role includes hiring teachers, sales executives, counsellors, and support staff, along with payroll, employee relations, performance management, HR operations, and separation processes.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment and Hiring

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for teachers, sales executives, counsellors, HR, administration, and other operational roles.
* Understand manpower requirements and prepare appropriate job descriptions.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, recruitment agencies, and local networks.
* Screen applications, conduct initial interviews, coordinate technical or demo rounds, and negotiate salaries.
* Verify candidate documents, references, qualifications, and employment history.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, employment contracts, and joining documents.
* Maintain recruitment reports and ensure vacancies are filled within agreed timelines.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for frequently hired positions.

Onboarding and Employee Records

* Conduct onboarding and induction for new employees.
* Collect and verify identity, education, banking, tax, and previous\-employment documents.
* Create and maintain accurate physical and digital employee records.
* Explain company policies, responsibilities, performance expectations, and workplace standards.
* Manage confirmation, transfer, promotion, salary revision, and employment\-status documentation.

Payroll and Attendance

* Manage monthly payroll processing from start to finish.
* Verify attendance, leave, late arrivals, incentives, commissions, deductions, advances, and unpaid leave.
* Coordinate salary calculations for teaching, sales, and support teams.
* Prepare and verify payroll statements and salary slips.
* Coordinate statutory deductions and compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS, bonus, and gratuity, wherever applicable.
* Resolve employee payroll and attendance queries promptly.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of all compensation information.

HR Operations and Compliance

* Manage daily HR administration and ensure smooth implementation of HR policies.
* Develop and update policies relating to attendance, leave, conduct, performance, incentives, discipline, and separation.
* Maintain employee databases, leave records, attendance reports, payroll files, and statutory registers.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour and employment laws.
* Coordinate with management, finance, legal advisers, and external consultants when required.
* Prepare HR reports covering headcount, vacancies, attendance, attrition, payroll, and employee performance.

Performance and Employee Relations

* Establish measurable performance goals and KPIs for teachers, sales employees, counsellors, and support teams.
* Coordinate probation reviews, performance appraisals, promotions, salary revisions, and performance\-improvement plans.
* Monitor employee conduct, productivity, attendance, and workplace behaviour.
* Address employee complaints, conflicts, grievances, and disciplinary concerns fairly and confidentially.
* Support managers with coaching, feedback, warnings, and corrective\-action processes.
* Organize employee engagement, training, recognition, and retention initiatives.

Separation and Termination

* Manage resignations, notice periods, handovers, exit interviews, and employee clearance.
* Handle disciplinary action and termination processes professionally, consistently, and in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Conduct or coordinate fair investigations before recommending disciplinary action.
* Prepare warning letters, show\-cause notices, termination letters, relieving letters, and experience certificates.
* Coordinate full\-and\-final settlements, recovery of company property, access removal, and closure of employee records.
* Maintain complete and confidential documentation for every separation decision.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience managing recruitment, payroll, HR operations, and employee relations.
* Experience hiring teachers and sales professionals is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Indian payroll practices and employment compliance.
* Experience using job portals, HRMS, attendance systems, Excel, and Google Workspace.
* Strong interviewing, negotiation, documentation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive and confidential matters with maturity.
* Capable of working independently and coordinating directly with senior management.

Key Performance Indicators

* Time taken to fill open positions.
* Quality and retention of new hires.
* Payroll accuracy and on\-time salary processing.
* Accuracy of attendance and employee records.
* Employee turnover and absenteeism.
* Timely completion of appraisals and HR documentation.
* Compliance with company policies and applicable laws.

How to Apply

Send your updated résumé to **hr@iitplanet.com** with the subject line **“Application for HR Executive/Manager – IIT Planet.”**

* Support internal audits and ensure compliance with employment laws and company policies.
* Contribute to process documentation, SOP updates, and knowledge base documentation to drive efficiency in a tiered service delivery model
* Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence and other HR functions to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Participate in projects and provide input from an operational perspective.
* Manage workload effectively, prioritizing based on business needs.
**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources , Business Administration, or related field.

* Hands\-on experience with Workday HCM and HR ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Workday Help). 
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work independently with moderate supervision.
* Demonstrates ethical behaviour and commitment to compliance.

title: IT Technician
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and responsible IT Technician to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support computer systems, network devices, CCTV systems, software, and other IT infrastructure. The candidate will provide technical assistance to users, resolve hardware and software issues, and ensure that all IT equipment operates securely and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and maintain desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, servers, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi devices, and other IT equipment.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, internet, and operating system problems.
* Provide technical support to users through phone, remote access, email, and on\-site visits.
* Install and configure Windows operating systems, drivers, antivirus software, office applications, and other business software.
* Configure and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, VLAN, IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, and basic routing.
* Install, configure, and maintain CCTV cameras, NVRs, DVRs, PoE switches, access\-control systems, and related surveillance equipment.
* Monitor network connectivity and coordinate with internet service providers for link\-related issues.
* Perform preventive maintenance of computers, network devices, UPS systems, and other IT equipment.
* Manage user accounts, passwords, permissions, shared folders, and system access.
* Maintain records of IT assets, equipment allocation, repairs, warranties, and software licences.
* Take regular backups and assist in restoring data when required.
* Follow cybersecurity practices, including antivirus updates, patch management, access control, and data protection.
* Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers or vendors.
* Prepare technical reports, service records, network diagrams, and troubleshooting documentation.
* Support IT deployment and maintenance activities at multiple project or client locations.
* Ensure compliance with organisational IT policies and safety procedures.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma, ITI, BCA, B.Sc. IT, B.Tech, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware, Windows operating systems, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and network cabling.
* Knowledge of CCTV, NVR, DVR, IP cameras, PoE, and surveillance systems will be preferred.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office, remote\-support tools, antivirus solutions, and backup systems.
* Ability to read technical manuals and follow installation procedures.

Required Skills

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of computer hardware and networking.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple service requests.
* Good communication and user\-support skills.
* Willingness to travel to different sites when required.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle urgent technical issues.
* Basic documentation and reporting skills.
* Attention to detail and a service\-oriented attitude.

Preferred Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, networking, CCTV, or field technical services.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge may also apply.
* Experience in multi\-site IT infrastructure, surveillance projects, or field support will be an advantage.

Employment Type

Full\-time

Work Location

Office and project sites, as required

Reporting To

Network Engineer, Project Manager

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

About Us
  
  

Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.
  
  

​
  
  

Why Join ByteDance
  
  

Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life \- a mission we work towards every day.
  
  

​
  
  

As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. ​

​
  
  

ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. ​
  
  

Trust \& Safety at ByteDance
  
  

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every\-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis.
  
  

​
  
  

​
  
  

ByteDance recognises that keeping our platform safe for the ByteDance communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining.
  
  

​
  
  

​
  
  

We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence\-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person\-centred, innovative and integrated approach.

title: Talent Attraction
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------


This role plays a central part in localizing and activating the employment value proposition (EVP) for the India market, ensuring core brand messages resonate with the local talent landscape while maintaining consistency with the enterprise employment brand strategy. This individual will lead initiatives across employer branding, recruitment marketing, candidate experience, employee recognition, and early careers to support the U.S. Bancorp India GCC growth and long\-term talent pipeline.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Localize and activate the global EVP for the India market, ensuring core brand messages are adapted to resonate with local talent while staying consistent with the enterprise employment brand strategy.
* Conduct local talent market research to understand candidate motivators, cultural nuances, and competitive employer positioning, leveraging employee focus groups, pulse surveys, and market data to inform EVP messaging and content.
* Develop and execute a localized employer branding strategy that positions U.S. Bancorp India as an employer of choice in India's competitive GCC landscape, including branded content, employee testimonials, and social media campaigns tailored to platforms such as LinkedIn, Naukri, and Glassdoor.
* Partner with India\-based leadership, HR, and communications teams to embed the EVP across all employee lifecycle touchpoints, from job descriptions and recruitment marketing to onboarding, internal communications, and career development materials.
* Build an employee advocacy and storytelling program that activates real employee voices in India, showcasing authentic career journeys, global impact stories, and the "founding member" experience to attract both lateral and early\-career talent.
* Design and implement recruitment marketing campaigns that attract high\-quality talent and enhance the end\-to\-end candidate experience, including engagement, communication, and feedback loops across active and passive talent.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition teams to improve pipeline quality, conversion metrics, and offer\-to\-join outcomes.
* Develop and execute an early careers/university talent attraction strategy for the India site, including campus recruiting programs, university partnerships, and internship or graduate rotational pipelines that build a sustainable pipeline of intern and full\-time candidates aligned to GCC hiring priorities.
* Build relationships and lead campus engagement with top\-tier engineering, business, and technology institutions to position U.S. Bancorp India as a preferred employer through career fairs, hackathons, innovation challenges, and on\-campus brand activations.
* Design early careers employer brand content and campaigns that speak to Gen Z and early\-career talent motivators — including career growth visibility, mentorship, global exposure, learning opportunities, and purpose\-driven work — and support structured onboarding, mentorship, and development pathways that drive first\-year retention.
* Partner with HR and India site leadership to activate the employee recognition platform, incorporating everyday recognition, work anniversaries, and celebrations tied to local cultural moments.
* Collaborate with global recognition program owners to ensure India\-specific efforts integrate with enterprise\-wide frameworks while allowing meaningful local customization, developing frameworks and best practices to answer questions and provide training opportunities.
* Monitor recognition quality and program usage and “coach” for appropriate use, communicating with team members at all levels as needed.
* Drive initiatives focused on employee engagement, culture building, and retention, and support DEI\-driven programs through brand storytelling and communication strategies.
* Lead development of content, storytelling, and communication strategies across digital and offline channels, partnering with global Marketing and Communications teams to amplify employer brand visibility and build thought leadership in India.
* Partner with senior leaders, HRBPs, cross\-functional teams, and external vendors to align priorities and ensure consistent execution.
* Evaluate and measure program success through insights, analytics, and metrics — including engagement, hiring outcomes, retention trends, campus conversion, and recognition participation — reporting results to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Five (5\) or more years of related experience in employer branding, talent marketing, recruitment, HR communications, or program management with proven ability to deliver results

**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Experience in GCC setup, high\-growth, or transformation environments, with proven ability to build and scale employer branding strategies
* Significant experience in employer branding, recruitment marketing, and reputation management within the India talent market
* Demonstrated ability to localize global brand strategies while maintaining enterprise alignment
* Experience designing early careers and campus recruiting programs, including university partnerships and brand activations
* Experience designing employee recognition programs that drive engagement and retention
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functionally and build collaborative partnerships across the organization
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to track and interpret hiring, engagement, and brand metrics to drive decisions
* Ability to adapt, be flexible, and pivot quickly while managing multiple projects in an ambiguous, fast\-paced environment
* Innovative, resourceful, and solutions\-oriented; actively seeks opportunities to continuously improve programs and candidate experience
* Deep understanding of social media and talent channels relevant to the India market (LinkedIn, Naukri, Glassdoor, etc.)
* Strong organizational, interpersonal, and team\-building skills — excellent written and verbal communication, including presentation skills and strong attention to detail
* PC/Microsoft skills including intermediate Outlook, SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; working knowledge of Workday reporting, metrics, and analytics


If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.


**Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.**


This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO / Operations Support Coordinator - Mumbai, India
description:
Company Overview
  
DentistFind is a leading marketing technology company based in Canada, with 15 years of expertise in empowering dental practices across the globe. Our mission is to facilitate seamless and sustainable growth for dental practices through our innovative PracticeFuel platform, which leverages data\-driven digital marketing strategies and cutting\-edge technology solutions. By focusing on increasing patient acquisition and retention, DentistFind provides a stable and prestigious work environment that offers opportunities for growth and international exposure.
  
Our comprehensive approach combines advanced technology with personalized consultation, equipping dental professionals with the tools and guidance necessary to achieve their goals. The intuitive platform delivers real\-time notifications, actionable reports, and performance reviews, while our expert consultants offer tailored training and support. This focus on ease of use and collaboration allows dental practices to concentrate on delivering exceptional patient care, ensuring steady growth and success in the ever\-evolving dental industry.
  
Why Join DentistFind?
  
At DentistFind, we believe in clarity over complexity, extreme ownership, and building systems that scale. As a rapidly growing dental marketing and technology partner, we empower dental practices with data\-driven strategies, cutting\-edge tools, and a relentless focus on measurable outcomes. Join us to be a part of a team that values innovation, efficiency, and client success.
  
Job Overview
  
DentistFind is seeking a high\-caliber Executive Assistant to the CEO / Operations Support Coordinator to act as the CEO’s cognitive filter and execution engine. This role sits at the center of the business, turning messy conversations, scattered information, and raw meeting notes into clear decisions, structured plans, and reliable follow\-through across Sales, Marketing, HR, Client Success, and Operations. You will reduce CEO drag, improve meeting quality, coordinate cross\-functional work, and maintain the operating systems that keep the company moving quickly and intelligently. This is a fast\-paced, remote role for someone who thinks in systems, thrives on challenge, and wants to help build performance and sales machines for a growing, technology\-driven dental marketing company.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
**CEO Support \& Information Filtering:** Review and refine documents, reports, and updates before they reach the CEO to ensure they answer the original business question, include supporting data, and have clear owners and deadlines; send back low\-quality or incomplete work with specific, respectful feedback.
  
  

**Meeting Preparation \& Pre\-Reads:** Prepare structured agendas and collect updates prior to leadership and project meetings; create concise pre\-reads that highlight key metrics, issues, and decisions required from the CEO and stakeholders.
  
  

**Meeting Notes \& Action Tracking:** Take clear, structured notes during meetings, capturing decisions, owners, deadlines, and blockers; convert discussions into action items in project tools, follow\-up messages, and updated trackers.
  
  

**Operating Systems \& Trackers:** Build, maintain, and improve operating systems such as CEO Review Trackers, meeting trackers, task and project trackers, performance/experiment logs, and sales/partner tracking sheets to ensure visibility and accountability.
  
  

**SOPs \& Process Documentation:** Create, refine, and standardize SOPs, checklists, templates, and process documents for recurring workflows (e.g., onboarding, performance reviews, campaign launches, reporting cadences).
  
  

**Performance System Support:** Support the design and maintenance of a performance system that logs tests and experiments, tracks results, documents debriefs, and standardizes winning approaches across clients.
  
  

**Sales System Support:** Help structure and maintain a simple, visible sales system and partner pipeline by tracking leads, partner activities, stages, and outcomes, ensuring the CEO and team have clear visibility on revenue motion.
  
  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Coordinate follow\-ups, dependencies, and deliverables across Marketing, Development, Client Success, HR, and Operations to make sure work escalated to the CEO is complete, structured, and decision\-ready.
  
  

**Analytics \& Executive Summaries:** Synthesize data, transcripts, and multi\-source information into concise executive summaries and decision briefs that allow the CEO to act quickly with clear context, options, and implications.
  
  

**AI\-Enabled Workflows:** Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) to summarize long documents and meeting transcripts, draft SOPs and templates, structure messy information, and improve the clarity and quality of written communication.
  
  

**Other Duties:** Perform other ad hoc tasks and special projects as assigned by the Manager or CEO.
  
  

Required Skills and Qualifications
  
**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Communications, Marketing, or a related field (required).
  
  

**Professional Experience:** Minimum 5 years of experience in roles such as Executive Assistant to CEO/Founder/Senior Executive, Operations Coordinator/Online Business Manager, or Project Manager/Junior Chief of Staff in a service, tech, or marketing environment (required).
  
  

**Remote Operations Experience:** Proven experience working in remote, distributed teams and collaborating across multiple time zones and cultures (required).
  
  

**Executive Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; demonstrated ability to produce CEO\-ready briefs, structured meeting notes, and clear, actionable follow\-up messages (required).
  
  

**Critical Thinking \& Judgment:** Strong ability to understand business objectives behind tasks, separate facts from assumptions, identify missing information, and challenge vague or low\-quality inputs constructively (required).
  
  

**Organization \& Follow\-Through:** Highly organized, self\-motivated, and proactive; proven track record of managing multiple streams of work, tracking owners and deadlines, and consistently closing loops until completion (required).
  
  

**Systems \& Process Orientation:** Ability to build, document, and maintain trackers, SOPs, checklists, and basic operating systems that improve clarity, speed, and accountability (required).
  
  

**Tools \& Technology:** Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Drive) and at least one project management tool (e.g., Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Airtable); comfortable using meeting transcription tools and AI tools like ChatGPT for summarization and documentation (required).
  
  

**Values Alignment:** Demonstrated commitment to analytical decision making, speed and agility, strategic/performance focus, continuous improvement, integrity, transparency, and thriving in challenging, fast\-paced environments (required).
  
  

**Discretion \& Professionalism:** Proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism (required).
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
**Industry Experience:** Experience in marketing agencies, SaaS/technology businesses, healthcare, or dental\-related companies (preferred).
  
  

**Founder/CEO Support:** Prior experience supporting a fast\-moving founder or CEO in a growth\-stage or entrepreneurial environment (preferred).
  
  

**Sales/Client Service Context:** Exposure to recurring services, retainers, or subscription\-style businesses serving small or medium\-sized clients, especially in North America (preferred).
  
  

**Process \& Playbook Development:** Experience creating SOPs, checklists, playbooks, or operating rhythms (e.g., weekly reviews, scorecards, meeting cadences) that improved team execution (preferred).
  
  

**Data \& Reporting:** Comfort working with basic dashboards, reports, and performance metrics; experience helping to design or maintain simple reporting systems (preferred).
  
  

**CRM \& Pipeline Familiarity:** Familiarity with CRM tools and basic pipeline tracking for leads, partners, or accounts (preferred).
  
  

**Remote \& Cross\-Cultural Collaboration:** Strong history of working effectively with international remote teams (e.g., Philippines, Nigeria, Pakistan, Indonesia, India, etc.) and adapting communication style across cultures (preferred).
  
  

**Project/Process Certifications:** Additional training or certifications in project management, operations, or process improvement (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Lean, Six Sigma) (preferred).
  
  

**Transcript \& Content Synthesis:** Demonstrated ability to convert long\-form content—such as meeting transcripts, discovery calls, or strategy sessions—into concise, action\-oriented executive briefs (preferred).
  
  

Ideal Candidate
  
The ideal candidate is a hybrid of an Executive Assistant, junior Chief of Staff, and Operations Coordinator. You are energized by turning chaos into clarity. You enjoy reading long, messy threads or transcripts and turning them into a single page of what matters: decisions, owners, deadlines, and risks. You are not afraid to challenge unclear requests, ask hard questions, or send work back for improvement before it reaches the CEO. You thrive in a fast\-paced, tech\-enabled environment where speed, thinking from first principles, and continuous improvement are core expectations, not aspirations. You think in systems, not tasks; you take extreme ownership of outcomes; and you are motivated by helping build the performance and sales systems of a company with proven products and big ambitions.
  
Company Culture \& Values
  
**Analytical Decision Making:** Data\-driven strategies guide our decisions.
  
  

**Speed \& Agility:** We prioritize efficiency and speed in execution.
  
  

**Strategic Focus:** Long\-term success through strategic actions.
  
  

**Continuous Improvement:** Relentless pursuit of excellence and growth.
  
  

**Integrity \& Transparency:** Building trust through honesty and accountability.
  
  

**Challenge\-Oriented:** Embracing challenges as opportunities for innovation.
  
  

What We Offer
  
Opportunity to work in a fast\-paced, innovative environment.
  
  

Ability to make a significant impact on the growth and success of dental practices.
  
  

Professional development and growth opportunities as we build advanced performance and sales systems.
  
  

A collaborative and supportive remote work culture that values ownership and continuous improvement.
  
  

Opportunities to be part of a global team with members from 9\+ different countries.
  
  

Work Environment and Work Hours
  
**Set\-up:** Full\-time, Remote
  
  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, for 7\.5 working hours between 6 AM and 5 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST).
  
  

**Shift options:** 6 AM–2 PM (1st shift) ; 9 AM–5 PM (2nd shift)
  
  

**Remote Work:** At DentistFind, we operate in a fully remote environment. We utilize a time\-tracking tool that captures screenshots at random intervals to ensure accountability and productivity. Candidates must be comfortable with this setup. If you have any concerns regarding the use of a time\-tracking tool, we strongly advise against applying to ensure alignment with our work practices.
  
  

The Team
  
You will be part of a dynamic and diverse team spread across the globe, including regions like Canada, the Philippines, Nigeria, Pakistan, Indonesia, Jamaica, Malaysia, Bangladesh, and India. As part of a remote\-first organization, the team values open communication, collaboration, and a shared commitment to the company’s mission. You will work closely with the marketing and sales team and various department heads, playing a pivotal role in ensuring alignment and advancing strategic objectives.
  
Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion
  
DentistFind is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive, diverse team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
  
How to Apply
  
Interested candidates should submit their resume, cover letter, and any relevant portfolio pieces demonstrating their expertise and success stories. You are encouraged to apply directly through our official job board for a more streamlined application process. This ensures your application is reviewed promptly by our recruitment team. Click here to apply and become a part of our team.

* A strategic, data\-informed recruiter who is comfortable advising and influencing senior leaders and hiring managers.

* A collaborative team player who values partnership with cross\-functional stakeholders and contributes to a strong Talent Acquisition culture.
* An organized, detail\-oriented professional who can prioritize multiple searches and initiatives while maintaining a high\-quality candidate experience.
* A confident communicator who can facilitate discussions, lead meetings, and represent Gigamon’s brand effectively in the talent market.

title: Product & Technology Recruiter
description:
**About Techdome**
------------------


Techdome is a product\-driven technology company building AI\-first platforms across Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, Enterprise Automation, and Payments.
At Techdome, hiring isn't just about filling positions—it's about identifying exceptional talent, creating outstanding candidate experiences, and building high\-performing teams that drive innovation.
We're looking for recruiters who think strategically, leverage AI to hire smarter, and thrive in a fast\-paced product environment.**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a **Talent Acquisition Specialist** who can independently manage the complete recruitment lifecycle—from understanding hiring requirements and sourcing exceptional talent to interview coordination, offer management, and successful candidate onboarding.
You'll work closely with Hiring Managers, Engineering Leaders, Product Teams, and Business Stakeholders to build strong talent pipelines while delivering an exceptional candidate experience.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **End\-to\-End Recruitment**

* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle for technical and non\-technical hiring.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs and define hiring strategies.
* Source quality candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, referrals, social hiring, and networking.
* Conduct structured screening interviews to assess technical alignment, communication skills, and cultural fit.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

### **Candidate Experience**

* Deliver a seamless and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Maintain proactive communication with candidates to reduce drop\-offs.
* Act as the primary point of contact from initial screening through offer acceptance.

### **Interview Management**

* Coordinate interviews across multiple stakeholders and hiring panels.
* Manage interview scheduling, feedback collection, and hiring timelines.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, hiring pipelines, and recruitment metrics using ATS platforms such as KEKA Hire.

### **Offer Management**

* Lead salary discussions and offer negotiations while maintaining internal parity.
* Drive offer closures and ensure smooth candidate onboarding.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure timely documentation and joining formalities.

### **Recruitment Excellence**

* Monitor hiring metrics including TAT, offer\-to\-join ratio, pipeline conversion, and hiring efficiency.
* Prepare recruitment dashboards and hiring reports for leadership.
* Continuously improve hiring processes through automation, analytics, and best practices.
* Support employer branding, campus hiring, and recruitment initiatives as required.

**AI\-First Recruitment**
-------------------------


At Techdome, AI is an integral part of modern recruiting.
We're looking for recruiters who actively leverage AI to improve sourcing, screening, communication, and hiring productivity.
Experience with tools such as:* ChatGPT
* Claude
* Gemini
* Perplexity
* LinkedIn Recruiter AI
* HireEZ
* AmazingHiring
* SeekOut


Candidates should be comfortable using AI for:* Boolean Search Optimization
* Candidate Sourcing
* Resume Screening
* Interview Preparation
* Job Description Creation
* Candidate Communication
* Recruitment Analytics
* Workflow Automation

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* 1–3 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Internal Recruitment.
* Experience hiring for technical roles in product, startup, or IT environments.
* Hands\-on experience with ATS platforms such as KEKA Hire or similar.
* Strong sourcing expertise across LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, job boards, referrals, and social hiring channels.
* Excellent stakeholder management and interview coordination skills.
* Strong negotiation and offer management abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* High ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Willingness to work from the Hyderabad or Indore office.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------


Experience in any of the following will be an added advantage:* Technical Hiring
* Product Hiring
* Employer Branding
* Campus Recruitment
* Recruitment Marketing
* Hiring Analytics \& Dashboards
* Diversity Hiring
* Social Hiring
* Recruitment Process Automation

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role**
----------------------------------------------

* Thinks beyond sourcing and owns hiring outcomes.
* Builds meaningful relationships with candidates and hiring managers.
* Uses AI and data to improve recruitment efficiency.
* Balances speed with quality while delivering an excellent candidate experience.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth product environment.
* Continuously looks for better ways to attract and hire top talent.

**Why Join Techdome?**
----------------------

* Be part of an AI\-first product company shaping the future of Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, and Enterprise Automation.
* Work closely with founders, engineering leaders, and product teams.
* Build high\-impact teams using modern recruitment practices.
* Gain exposure to cutting\-edge technologies and AI\-driven hiring.
* Accelerate your career in a fast\-growing product organization.

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* HR Screening
* Functional Interview
* Leadership Discussion

title: Equities Business Management - AVP
description:
Date live: 08/07/2026


Business Area: Pan Markets


Area of Expertise: Business Management


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000126511


  
Join us as an “Equities Business Management \- AVP” Business Management function is broad ranging and involves responsibility for the strategy, the infrastructure and administration of the business. There is particular emphasis on strategy, execution of initiatives/projects, budgeting, risk control agenda, and cost control.


To be a successful “Equities Business Management \- AVP” candidate is expected to work in a high intensity, result oriented team environment as part of the Equities Business Management Team in Mumbai, which is a virtual extension of Global Business Management Team. The Business Management function is broad ranging and involves a rich set of responsibilities such as streamlining business processes and managing costs or supporting the delivery of technology with agility to support all investment strategies.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success role has particular emphasis on strategy, budgeting, cost control, and risk and controls. It involves constant liaison with, and often provides the link between, trading and IT, Product Control, Risk Control, Operations, Legal and Compliance, as well as working closely with Sales \& Trading. As such, it is key to the smooth and efficient running of the business and touches the firm in most areas and at all levels.


**Basic/ Essential Qualifications:**


* Be the business face\-off with Markets Risk and Control, Legal, Risk, HR, PCG, Audit, Compliance, BCM, and ORM teams, ensuring we operate an effective control environment for the Equities business.
* Conduct deep dive on Industry benchmarking and competitor analysis (e.g. Coalition, McLagan)
* Co\-ordination of firm\-wide strategic initiatives / project management.
* Be a leading participant on the management business review analysis.
* Have an oversight of strategic business initiatives, including evaluation of new and existing investments.
* Communication and articulation of business strategy for Senior Management especially for Town Halls, results reporting and communication, industry roundtables, etc.
* Review of various pricing arrangements with e.g. brokers, clearing houses.
* Work with support functions to identify opportunities to reduce consumed costs.
* Deliver Planning and Stress Testing by providing inputs to annual budgeting process \-revenue, client revenue, FO costs, RWA/LBS, and technology deliverables.
* Represent Front Office in governance forums (e.g. asset class control meetings, thematic requirements – e.g. Volcker, Best Execution, Product Governance, risk review committees)
* Periodic evaluation of business leadership construct, reorganizations, headcount shape and ongoing human capital requirements.
* Business planning and monitoring support e.g. Business MI and Strategy Presentations, key Performance Indicators (KPI) and trend analysis, etc.
* Production management reports on P\&L, Client Revenue, Trading revenues, volumes, margins, market share, Expenses / Profitability, Capital – RWA and Balance Sheet etc.
* Coordinate/Collate materials for business updates \& governance forums including Exco meetings.
* Proactively own management of business commentaries and client highlights for the client strategy team, use it in weekly, monthly management meeting packs.
* Conduct deep dive performance analysis proactively and propose strategic actionable insights for the head of business
* Ad\-hoc customized analysis as required by the business managers to analyse the business performance or lead/lag indicators.

**Desirable skillsets/ good to have:**


* Good understanding of Markets business with specific focus on Equities and Prime brokerage.
* Strong Leadership and team management skills.
* Vision for business growth and be able to relate to strategic mindset of the business head.
* Experience of creating, enhancing and producing Business MI.
* Good PowerPoint and excel knowledge.
* Excellent communication skills (oral/written) as the candidate would have to work closely with the on shore teams globally.
* Aptitude for self\-learning – Should be able to demonstrate a self\-learning attitude.
* Proactive in nature. Should be able to take decisions and support those.
* Strong automation skills with hands on expertise on VBA, Python, dashboarding in Qlikview and Tableau.

This role will be based out of NKP, Mumbai.


**Purpose of the role**


To enable the success of the business and assist senior leaders navigate complex challenges, make informed decisions, and achieve their goals


**Accountabilities**


* Collaboration with business and senior leadership to develop and implement business strategies that align with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Liaison between different business units and functions, fostering communication and collaboration.
* Management and coordination of strategic initiatives, projects, and change management efforts to optimize business processes and strengthen the control environment.
* Improvement of operational efficiency within the organisation including the identification of areas for improvement, streamlining of processes, and implementation of best practices to enhance productivity and effectiveness.
* Development of performance reporting for key metrics that reinforce the strategic objectives of the division and support the external commitments made. Involvement in aspects of financial analysis and budget management, including assistance in financial planning, forecasting, and monitoring of financial performance against targets.
* Support to business heads in partnership with HR on hiring, workforce planning, joiner/mover/leaver actions.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Culture and Team Success (CTS) Executive
description:
**Job Brief:**
Culture and Team Success (CTS) Executive \- the purpose of this role is both practical and motivational. It goes beyond traditional HR. It is different from traditional talent leadership. In this CTS role, you would be a purpose\-driven who would work to infuse the workplace with empathy, humanity, and joy. **Essential Responsibilities:*** A person who understands the pulse of every single person in the company
* A person who oversees employees’ well\-being and overall satisfaction
* You would bring exceptional Emotional optimism – and should see each employee as “hearts” with meaningful work and life desires, and not just pure “resources”
* Someone who understands what it means to connect heart and hustle – and work with employees to integrate heart into their professional lives and inspire them to become the very best version of themselves and propel them to leadership roles.
* Someone who will revolutionize the way we think, live and act about hiring—not just for skill set, but for culture addition.
* Doesn't simply look for short\-term changes in tactics; looks for long\-term impacts in culture.


Your daily routine in the CTS role would consist of reaching out to people, having one\-on\-one conversations, understanding the underlying issues, recommending multiple solutions, and implementing the right – not necessarily the best solution – in a very consultative and collaborative manner* Building and fostering teams committed to continuing and building our culture
* Enabling employees to feel secure
* Hiring the right people
* Frequent and fair performance reviews and rewarding best performers
* Find a way to overcome the gaps between employee’s expectations and reality
* To have a finger on the pulse of who needs mentorship, who needs a chat, who needs a team change, and who needs anything whatsoever.

 **The Purpose of your role – as a CTS Executive.**
CTS should know what the person/employee is seeking. What are they searching for? Is it that they are stuck in a career, or they don’t know how to ask for a raise? His/her purpose: trying to unlock what it is they’re all about.
You should thrive in removing roadblocks. So, bring a roadblock and you should love to work on it together with all parties involved.
How can you, in your CTS role use mentoring to unlock an employee’s inner professional potential?
To understand an employee, the CTS would employ various ways. Sometimes, it can be the energy they can read and get from whoever is sitting in front. Pick up on body language, pick up on ways in which they are talking about themselves or talking about their team. A CTS should always start from a place of unconditional empathy.
To engage and retain employees, the CTS should use mentoring as an avenue for career growth in this very young and shifting workforce.
You should believe that \- People will forget what you said or what you did, but people will never forget how you made them feel. **Reporting:**
The CTS Executive will report to the Sr. Manager\-HR and will have the opportunity to work with the senior management team within the organization. You'll get to be, a part "owner" of the company's strategy and vision. **About Integrative Systems:**
We are a reputable 20\+\-year\-old software development and back\-office optimization firm based in Chicago with clients for Microsoft applications (desktop, web, and mobile), IBMi, JDA MMS, and BPCS throughout North America and Canada.* We have an exceptional work culture that is vibrant, and performance\-driven – A workplace that you will aspire to be a member of.
* We proactively work towards creating an environment – wherein every associate is incentivized to think independently; bring to bear diverse and dynamic resources to resolve complex problems collaboratively. And most importantly, understand the meaning and growth in their work.
* We work with a belief that everyone associated with Integrative should grow professionally and personally. Therefore, we seek out what's best for our co\- workers.
* We strive to create a workplace that 100 people would absolutely love, not a place that 1000 people kind of like. To achieve this, we try to create job experiences, not job opportunities.
* We know the importance of adding the 'FUN' in 'business fundamentals' at the right time \- yet are a well\-disciplined, profitable, well\-oiled engine of growth. So, when we hire new talent, we lookout for someone who can balance work\-life easily.
* We hire only the best. For a typical position, we sift through one hundred resumes and interview at least ten people. Make it in, and you'll be working with some of the best minds in the business. We understand that 'A' people attract 'A' people.
* We do not ride on anything short\-term \- no short\-term market trends, short\-term profits, or any short\-cuts. Hence, we look for talent who usually believes in stability and commitment more than short\-term benefits.
* We understand that when a person joins, he/she brings in various dimensions of their being \- physical, emotional, social, mental, and spiritual aspects to the workplace, not just vocational. And because we address all these dimensions for every associate's wellbeing, we create an environment that fosters optimism, mindfulness, authenticity, belongingness, meaning, and vitality.

title: Assistant Manager L&D
description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive team member training and development programs to enhance team skills and performance; assessing training needs, designing and updating training courses to ensure that the training content matches the team members' job responsibilities and career paths; managing training budgets to ensure maximum return on training investment. As a **Assistant Manager L\&D** , you’re not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.


  
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:


* **Develop training programs:** Design, plan, and deliver hotel training programs in alignment with corporate goals and industry standards, inclusive of topics such as harassment\-free workplace, diversity, new team member orientation, leadership, and service
* **Monitor and review performance:** Conduct meetings with department managers, trainers, and team members to review performance trends, develop action plans, and recognize achievements
* **Deliver continuous improvement:** Assess existing training initiatives, identify opportunities for enhancement, and recommend solutions to address specific department needs
* **Manage training records:** Track, maintain, and audit individual team member training records using designated systems and tools
* **Oversee departmental training programs:** Manage and monitor department\-specific training programs such as alcohol awareness, food safety, job skills checklists, and educational assistance
* **Inspire and develop the team:** Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

  
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:


A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.


In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:


* Minimum 3 years in L\&D or HR, with a strong track record in designing, delivering, and evaluating training programs.
* Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Hospitality Management, or related field preferred.
* Skilled in instructional design, adult learning principles, and modern training methods (e.g., e\-learning, blended learning).
* Proficient in assessing training effectiveness and aligning programs with business goals.
* Experienced with Learning Management Systems (LMS), digital training tools, and Microsoft Office.
* Strong verbal and written skills; able to engage and motivate diverse teams.
* Committed to continuous learning and staying updated on emerging training trends.
* Proven ability to work cross\-functionally to identify needs and support performance improvement.
* Capable of managing training teams and multiple projects effectively.

  
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**  

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
The HR Business Partner (HRBP) will act as a strategic and operational partner to business leaders across India and the wider APAC region. This role combines core HRBP responsibilities with an emphasis on Talent Acquisition (TA) delivery, ensuring the attraction, selection, and onboarding of high\-quality talent aligned to business priorities.


The role will support business growth by driving workforce planning, end\-to\-end recruitment, and people initiatives, while partnering closely with regional leadership and Centres of Excellence (CoEs). They will operate as a hands\-on, delivery\-focused HR Business Partner, with a strong bias for action and accountability across the full employee lifecycle. This role requires a “doer” mindset, balancing strategic partnering with direct execution across recruitment, employee relations, and core HR processes.

  

  

**JOB DUTIES:**

* Partner with business leaders across India and APAC, as well as stakeholders in the US and EMEA, to understand organisational priorities and translate them into strategic people plans.
* Provide day\-to\-day HR guidance on employee relations, performance management, restructuring, and organisational design
* Support leaders in driving engagement, capability building, and organisational effectiveness
* Act as a trusted advisor, balancing commercial needs with HR best practice
* Support with end\-to\-end recruitment delivery across India and selected APAC markets
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, job descriptions, and hiring strategy
* Work closely with Talent Acquisition partners
* Drive diversity hiring and ensure compliance with organisational hiring standards and governance
* Monitor key recruitment metrics (time\-to\-fill, quality of hire, candidate experience) and take corrective action

**YOU MUST HAVE:**

* Proven experience as an HRBP or HR generalist in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally across multiple regions (India/APAC exposure preferred)
* Solid understanding of Indian employment law and HR practices
* Comfortable working at both strategic and operational levels
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills
* Fluent English (written and spoken); additional European languages are a plus

**WE VALUE:**

  

* Action\-oriented with a strong delivery mindset
* Commercially aware and pragmatic
* High resilience and adaptability
* Strong ownership and accountability
* Collaboration, with the ability to build trust quickly

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Health Insurance Coverage
* Education Assistance
* Maternity \& Paternity Leave
* Menstrual Wellness Benefit
* Bereavement Leave

title: HR & Talent Specialist
description:
Job ID: 109042
Bengaluru
Chennai  


Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem\-solver who is energized by challenges? You’ve come to the right place.


YOUR IMPACT


Leveraging your expertise in talent management and stakeholder collaboration, you will drive the Professional Development domain operations and actively support the execution of our core Talent/PD strategy for the global VG\&Media function.


As a member of the HR\&Talent and VG\&Media People \& Culture teams, you will apply your end\-to\-end program management and planning skills to spearhead initiatives and PD operations to ultimately advance our talent objectives. You will be recognized and relied upon as a subject matter expert in the professional development domain.


You will leverage a core set of capabilities to drive the following outcomes:


Talent Strategy Design \& Execution


Apply Business Acumen: Translate functional business strategies into actionable talent priorities, defining and executing targeted talent measures within the VG\&Media function.


Leverage Organizational Design: Maintain and administer the path talent architecture, including defining role progressions, mapping skill codes, and structuring clear career paths.


Drive Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with key functional leaders to build clarity and consensus on overarching talent and performance management strategies.


Professional Development Domain Management


Provide Strategic Advisory \& Coaching: Serve as a trusted advisor to people leaders and individuals, offering expert counsel on career development, review and recognition cycles, and navigating performance issues (integrating subject matter experts to resolve complex challenges).


Execute Operational Excellence: Independently lead and seamlessly execute developmental milestones, Annual Reviews, and essential PD operations across VG\&Media.


Facilitate \& Influence: Convene and guide VG\&Media managers to align on professional development strategies, share best practices, and cultivate a culture of continuous growth.


Project Management


Drive Strategic Projects: Drive and manage cross\-cutting HR\&Talent initiatives that reinforce and scale the broader talent strategy across the global VG\&Media function.


Optimize Global Processes: Champion consistency across people processes by scaling and standardizing best practices for annual reviews and ongoing performance management.


Data Management \& Insights\-driven Collaboration


Apply Analytical Problem\-Solving: Analyze people and team metrics (e.g., advancement data, historical performance trends) to uncover insights that directly inform and shape our talent strategy.


Drive Data\-Informed Interventions: Track progress against developmental milestones, proactively identify core challenges, and architect creative solutions to achieve key PD outcomes in VG\&Media. Ensure Data Integrity: Manage core organizational data accuracy within firm systems (e.g., MyDev).


You will be based in Chennai or Bangalore, two of our primary India centers supporting the VG\&Media function.


YOUR GROWTH


You are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.


In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.
