title: Site Reliability Engineer, Litmus GCC
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
**Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible**
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

**Work on problems where software meets the real world**
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

**Have real impact, fast**
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

**Join a high\-performance team**
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Litmus Automation is hiring a Site Reliability Engineer to own the day\-to\-day reliability, security, and performance of our Azure\-hosted Litmus Unified Namespace (UNS) and Litmus Edge Manager (LEM) environment, deployed for a strategic enterprise customer. This role covers the full lifecycle: initial environment provisioning and hardening, deployment support, ongoing monitoring and incident response, and long\-term operation against a 99\.9% uptime commitment. You will work directly with customer\-facing infrastructure spanning AKS, Azure networking, managed databases, identity federation, and MQTT\-based data pipelines connecting multiple sites. As this is an SRE role held to a 99\.9% uptime commitment, it includes participation in an on\-call rotation to ensure continuous coverage and rapid incident response outside of standard working hours.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure spanning compute, container orchestration, networking, and database services.
* Own end\-to\-end monitoring and alerting, and build/maintain operational dashboards that give clear visibility into system health and performance.
* Drive response and on\-call support to meet uptime SLAs, including root cause analysis and post\-incident reviews.
* Implement and maintain a strong security baseline, including vulnerability management, secrets management, network security controls, and certificate lifecycle management.
* Configure and support identity/SSO integration between internal and customer identity providers, troubleshooting authentication issues as needed.
* Manage networking and connectivity to support reliable, high\-throughput data flows across distributed environments and sites.
* Monitor and report on infrastructure usage and consumption against agreed baselines; support capacity planning.
* Build and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD pipelines to automate provisioning and deployment.
* Manage backup and disaster recovery processes and periodically validate recovery procedures.
* Participate in customer\-facing environment validation, UAT support, and go\-live sign\-off activities.
* Maintain clear runbooks, documentation, and knowledge transfer materials for the environment.


**Required Qualifications**
* 4\-8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure roles, with significant hands\-on Azure experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with core Azure services: AKS, Virtual Machines, VNet/NSG/Load Balancer/Application Gateway, Azure Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.
* Practical experience administering and troubleshooting Kubernetes’ workloads in production.
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
* Proficiency in scripting/automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TLS/SSL, load balancing, firewalls/NSGs).
* Experience with incident management, on\-call rotations, and SLA\-driven operations.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with customer stakeholders during validation and escalations.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have**
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (Azure DevOps certification) is required.
* Experience with identity federation and SSO protocols (OIDC/SAML), particularly Key cloak and/or Okta.
* Familiarity with MQTT or other IoT/industrial data protocols.
* Additional certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
* Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial, or IoT customer environments.

The trainee will learn how to understand client requirements, configure ERPNext modules, develop basic customizations, prepare reports and workflows, support data migration, perform testing and assist during ERPNext implementation and go\-live.

Requirements and Process Understanding

Learn business processes across Accounting, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Manufacturing, CRM, Projects,HR and Payroll.
Map basic client requirements against standard ERPNext functionality.
ERPNext Configuration

Assist in configuring companies, taxes, naming series, approval processes and module settings.
Create custom fields, property settings, notifications, dashboards and basic workflows.
Prepare basic query reports, script reports and print formats under guidance.
Validate whether configured processes meet approved requirements.
Frappe and Technical Work
Learn ERPNext architecture and Frappe Framework concepts.
Write basic Python server scripts and JavaScript client scripts.
Understand DocTypes, document events, hooks, permissions and database relationships.
Assist in creating simple reports, scripts, APIs and customizations.
Support senior team members in troubleshooting ERPNext configuration and technical issues.
Use Git and follow the company’s coding and version\-control practices.
Data Migration and Testing
Prepare data\-import templates and clean client master data.
Write basic SQL queries for data extraction and validation.
Assist with data migration, reconciliation and error correction.
Prepare test cases and execute configuration, functional and regression testing.
Support UAT, defect tracking and validation of resolved issues.
Client Support and Documentation
Prepare user manuals, training material and configuration documentation.
Participate in system demonstrations and end\-user training.
Provide task updates to internal teams and project managers.
Support go\-live and post\-go\-live activities.
Maintain accurate implementation documents and project records.
Mandatory Skills
Basic Python programming knowledge.
Basic JavaScript knowledge.
Basic SQL and relational database understanding.
Understanding of HTML, CSS, JSON, HTTP and APIs.
Strong logical and analytical ability.
Good written and verbal communication.
Willingness to learn business processes and interact with clients.
Strong interest in developing both functional and technical ERPNext capabilities.
Preferred Qualification

Computer Science
Information Technology
Computer Applications
Information Systems
Engineering Or a related technical discipline
Candidates from Commerce or Business backgrounds may be considered when they demonstrate adequate programming, database and technical aptitude.
Key Performance Indicators
ERPNext and Frappe learning progress.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
**About Reelo :**Reelo is an all\-in\-one customer data, loyalty, and marketing automation platform trusted by 5,000\+ brands big and small across 9 countries and growing. Brands like Punjab Grill, Jumboking, Pop Tates, The Beer Cafe, Hakkasan, Roastery Coffee House, and many more use Reelo to grow faster.Founded in 2021 by brother duo Parin \& Prit Sanghvi, Reelo helps restaurants and retail businesses maximize their revenue and growth through a unified platform for loyalty, marketing, and data analytics. With Reelo, businesses can market like Starbucks, without the effort or expertise, driving more repeat customers, increasing sales, and building a stronger brand.As competition for customer attention intensifies, it has never been more important for restaurants and retail businesses to have a 360° view of their customers, the very people who keep them in business, and to engage with them using data to drive loyalty and revenue.Coming from a family of retail entrepreneurs, we understand this deeply: while it’s easier than ever to start a business, it’s harder than ever to grow one.Competition is fierce. Standing out is increasingly difficult, and businesses feel this pressure every day. Customer acquisition costs are rising, retention is challenging, and there’s too much to juggle, too many tools, too many disconnected solutions. Most existing platforms are complex, expensive, and built for sophisticated marketers at large enterprise brands.We identified two key challenges:

* Small and mid\-sized businesses don’t have the time to do data\-driven marketing.
* Those that do marketing often see poor results.

Reelo is on a mission to change this, permanently !!!Our SaaS platform makes it fast and easy for businesses to understand their customers and continuously engage with them in a smart, automated way, bringing them back again and again, and building lasting customer relationships.There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a business that is big, meaningful, and lasting. For that, we’re building a strong, diverse team of curious, creative people who want to find purpose in their work and support each other in the process. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.You can learn more about us here:**About the Role**We are looking for a driven and personable Sales Development Representative to join our team and help us grow our presence in the restaurant and food service industry. As an SDR, your core focus will be identifying and reaching out to restaurant owners, F\&B managers, and hospitality decision\-makers on LinkedIn to generate qualified leads and book discovery calls for our sales team.This is a WFO role based out of our office. You will be part of a close\-knit team, receive hands\-on training, and have clear targets and growth opportunities.**What You Will Do**

* Research and identify restaurant owners, chain managers, F\&B directors, and hospitality decision\-makers as target prospects.
* Send personalized LinkedIn connection requests and follow\-up messages to initiate conversations with potential clients.
* Craft compelling outreach messages tailored to the restaurant and food service universe — understanding their pain points around operations, costs, staff, and growth.
* Qualify prospects based on business size, interest level, and budget fit before handing them off to Account Executives.
* Book and schedule discovery calls or product demos for the sales team.
* Track all outreach activity, conversations, and follow\-ups in the CRM daily.
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline of restaurant leads at various stages.
* Follow up consistently and professionally to move prospects through the funnel.
* Share feedback from the restaurant market with the sales and marketing teams to improve messaging.

**Who You Are**

* Comfortable spending the majority of your day on LinkedIn — searching, messaging, and following up with prospects.
* A strong communicator who can write crisp, friendly, and persuasive messages that don't feel like spam.
* Curious about the restaurant industry — you enjoy learning how restaurants operate and what challenges they face.
* Resilient and target\-driven — you handle rejection well and stay motivated to hit your daily and monthly goals.
* Organized and detail\-oriented — you keep your CRM clean and your follow\-up schedule tight.
* A team player who shows up on time, collaborates actively in the office, and contributes to a positive team culture.

**Requirements**

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, business development, or client outreach (freshers with strong communication skills are welcome).
* Excellent written English — you will be crafting LinkedIn messages every single day.
* Basic familiarity with LinkedIn and how to use it for prospecting.
* Comfortable with CRM tools (training will be provided).
* Graduate in any discipline; background in Hospitality, Business, or Marketing is a plus.
* Must be willing to work full\-time from our office.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior knowledge of or experience in the restaurant, food service, or hospitality industry.
* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or outreach automation tools.
* Understanding of restaurant operations. What a GM, owner, or F\&B head deals with daily.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed salary \+ performance\-based incentives tied to meetings booked and pipeline generated.
* Structured onboarding with deep training on the restaurant industry and outreach best practices.
* Clear growth path — top performers move into full\-cycle sales, account management, or team lead roles.
* Energetic, collaborative office environment with a team that loves what it does.
* Front\-row seat to understanding one of India's most exciting and fast\-growing industries.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
**About Reelo :**

Reelo is an all\-in\-one customer data, loyalty, and marketing automation platform trusted by 5,000\+ brands big and small across 9 countries and growing. Brands like Punjab Grill, Jumboking, Pop Tates, The Beer Cafe, Hakkasan, Roastery Coffee House, and many more use Reelo to grow faster.Founded in 2021 by brother duo Parin \& Prit Sanghvi, Reelo helps restaurants and retail businesses maximize their revenue and growth through a unified platform for loyalty, marketing, and data analytics. With Reelo, businesses can market like Starbucks, without the effort or expertise, driving more repeat customers, increasing sales, and building a stronger brand.As competition for customer attention intensifies, it has never been more important for restaurants and retail businesses to have a 360° view of their customers, the very people who keep them in business, and to engage with them using data to drive loyalty and revenue.Coming from a family of retail entrepreneurs, we understand this deeply: while it’s easier than ever to start a business, it’s harder than ever to grow one.Competition is fierce. Standing out is increasingly difficult, and businesses feel this pressure every day. Customer acquisition costs are rising, retention is challenging, and there’s too much to juggle, too many tools, too many disconnected solutions. Most existing platforms are complex, expensive, and built for sophisticated marketers at large enterprise brands.We identified two key challenges:

* Small and mid\-sized businesses don’t have the time to do data\-driven marketing.
* Those that do marketing often see poor results.

Reelo is on a mission to change this, permanently !!!Our SaaS platform makes it fast and easy for businesses to understand their customers and continuously engage with them in a smart, automated way, bringing them back again and again, and building lasting customer relationships.

There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a business that is big, meaningful, and lasting. For that, we’re building a strong, diverse team of curious, creative people who want to find purpose in their work and support each other in the process. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.You can learn more about us here:**About the Role**We are looking for a driven and personable Sales Development Representative to join our team and help us grow our presence in the restaurant and food service industry. As an SDR, your core focus will be identifying and reaching out to restaurant owners, F\&B managers, and hospitality decision\-makers on LinkedIn to generate qualified leads and book discovery calls for our sales team.This is a WFO role based out of our office. You will be part of a close\-knit team, receive hands\-on training, and have clear targets and growth opportunities.

**What You Will Do**

* Research and identify restaurant owners, chain managers, F\&B directors, and hospitality decision\-makers as target prospects.
* Send personalized LinkedIn connection requests and follow\-up messages to initiate conversations with potential clients.
* Craft compelling outreach messages tailored to the restaurant and food service universe — understanding their pain points around operations, costs, staff, and growth.
* Qualify prospects based on business size, interest level, and budget fit before handing them off to Account Executives.
* Book and schedule discovery calls or product demos for the sales team.
* Track all outreach activity, conversations, and follow\-ups in the CRM daily.
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline of restaurant leads at various stages.
* Follow up consistently and professionally to move prospects through the funnel.
* Share feedback from the restaurant market with the sales and marketing teams to improve messaging.

**Who You Are**

* Comfortable spending the majority of your day on LinkedIn — searching, messaging, and following up with prospects.
* A strong communicator who can write crisp, friendly, and persuasive messages that don't feel like spam.
* Curious about the restaurant industry — you enjoy learning how restaurants operate and what challenges they face.
* Resilient and target\-driven — you handle rejection well and stay motivated to hit your daily and monthly goals.
* Organized and detail\-oriented — you keep your CRM clean and your follow\-up schedule tight.
* A team player who shows up on time, collaborates actively in the office, and contributes to a positive team culture.

**Requirements**

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, business development, or client outreach (freshers with strong communication skills are welcome).
* Excellent written English — you will be crafting LinkedIn messages every single day.
* Basic familiarity with LinkedIn and how to use it for prospecting.
* Comfortable with CRM tools (training will be provided).
* Graduate in any discipline; background in Hospitality, Business, or Marketing is a plus.
* Must be willing to work full\-time from our office.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior knowledge of or experience in the restaurant, food service, or hospitality industry.
* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or outreach automation tools.
* Understanding of restaurant operations. What a GM, owner, or F\&B head deals with daily.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed salary \+ performance\-based incentives tied to meetings booked and pipeline generated.
* Structured onboarding with deep training on the restaurant industry and outreach best practices.
* Clear growth path — top performers move into full\-cycle sales, account management, or team lead roles.
* Energetic, collaborative office environment with a team that loves what it does.
* Front\-row seat to understanding one of India's most exciting and fast\-growing industries.

Pay: From ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* What's your current salary?
* What's your expected salary?
* Currently we aren't providing laptops, do you have a laptop for job ?

* What is your total work experience in Sales/ Lead Generation ?
* Are you open to a fixed salary \+ performance\-based incentive structure?
* Have you used LinkedIn Sales Navigator or any outreach/prospecting tool before?
* Do you have any exposure to the restaurant, hospitality, or food service industry?

title: Social Media Designer Intern/ Fresher
description:
**About Sociali.ai**

Sociali.ai is an AI\-powered social media management platform helping brands create, schedule, and scale content effortlessly across multiple channels. It enables teams to generate creatives, captions, and full content calendars in minutes while maintaining brand consistency at scale.

We're building the future of social media, where AI handles the heavy lifting and creativity drives impact.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a Social Media Designer Intern who's excited about content and design and wants real\-world experience creating for live brands. You'll work closely with senior designers and the content team, learning to turn ideas into scroll\-stopping visuals using AI\-assisted workflows with guidance and feedback built into every step.

This is a great fit for a student, recent graduate, or early\-career designer who wants hands\-on exposure to content\-first, platform\-first, audience\-first design, without being expected to run things solo from day one.

**What You'll Do**

* **Create social media creatives** on the Sociali.ai platform, starting with smaller pieces and templated formats before moving to more complex briefs.
* **Practice translating content ideas** into visuals under the guidance of a senior designer, with regular feedback on speed and quality.
* **Support monthly content calendars** by contributing drafts and variations for the content \& marketing team to review.
* **Get hands\-on with AI tools** (including Sociali.ai) to generate and enhance creative outputs, with mentorship on how to use them effectively.
* **Help maintain brand consistency** across a smaller set of clients/brands to start, expanding as you build confidence.
* **Learn basic motion graphics / simple animation** (bonus, not required at entry).
* **Stay plugged into trends,** memes, formats, and platform changes, and bring fresh ideas to team discussions.
* **Get exposure to performance data** (engagement, CTR, etc.) and learn how it informs creative decisions, with a senior designer interpreting results alongside you.
* **Sit in on client conversations** to start understanding how brand vision gets translated into a creative brief.

**What We're Looking For**

* **A portfolio (student, personal, or freelance projects are welcome)** showing interest in social media\-first design work.
* **Proficiency in at least one design tool** (Canva, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar).
* **Growing understanding of content hooks, visual storytelling \& the attention economy**  coursework, self\-study, or personal projects count.
* **Willingness to design fast and iterate** based on feedback, without losing creative quality.
* **Curiosity about AI tools** (Midjourney, DALL·E, or similar) — prior experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* **Basic sense of copy \+ content strategy,** and openness to learning more.
* **Good communication skills** and comfort taking direction from creative briefs, with questions welcomed.
* **Basic video editing skills** are a nice\-to\-have, not required.

**Why Join Sociali.ai**

* Real, hands\-on experience working on a product that helps brands create content in minutes, not hours.
* Mentorship from senior designers and structured exposure to multi\-brand, large\-scale content systems.
* A genuine seat at the table in an AI\-first creative team, with room to grow into a full\-time Creative Designer role.
* The chance to build a strong, real\-world portfolio while you learn.

How to Apply

* **Portfolio** (student or personal projects are fine)
* **Resume**
* **1\-minute video** explaining why you'd be a great fit for this internship. (Faceless videos are fine. Be creative!)

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Customer Success Specialist Intern / Fresher
description:
**About the Mission**

Sociali is a fast\-growing B2B SaaS AI agency scaling our client operations systematically. We are looking for a Customer Success Specialist Intern who wants to build real, hands\-on experience managing software implementations and translating a brand's digital vision into high\-impact execution.

This is a learning\-first version of our Customer Success Specialist role, designed for someone early in their career. You'll work directly alongside experienced Customer Success Specialists and leadership, taking on real client\-facing responsibilities under guidance while you build the judgment and speed needed to eventually run accounts independently.

**Core Responsibilities**  
You'll be exposed to the same core areas as our full\-time Customer Success Specialists, at a scope and pace suited to someone building these skills for the first time:

1\. Guided Implementation \& Technical Execution

* **Supported Onboarding:** Assist with the initial setup sequence for new accounts — collecting client requirements, assets, and software linkages — under the direction of a senior Specialist.
* **Guided Troubleshooting:** Learn to manage technical account configurations (e.g., platform workflows, URL logic checks, Facebook Work Account setup) with a mentor available to unblock you on harder issues.
* **Structured System Learning:** Work through our existing process documentation and training materials to build platform fluency over your first few weeks, with regular check\-ins to track progress.

2\. Creative Quality \& Content Delivery

* **Creative Support:** Help translate client briefs into clear specifications for internal design and content teams, reviewed by a Specialist before they go out.
* **Quality Checks:** Review social media calendars and automated drafts for accuracy and brand fit, flagging anything unclear to your manager rather than resolving every edge case solo.
* **Brand Research:** Research client industries to surface content angles and opportunities, bringing ideas to your team for feedback.

3\. Account Scoping \& Process Exposure

* **Scoping Support:** Assist in gathering information for project scopes and pricing pitches, which are finalized and validated by management.
* **Process Documentation:** Note gaps or friction points in internal workflows and checklists, and suggest improvements for a senior team member to review.
* **Account Health Awareness:** Learn to read account health metrics and start recognizing patterns that could signal upsell opportunities, with guidance from your manager.

What We're Looking For

* **Eagerness to Learn:** You're resourceful and curious — when something is unclear, you try to figure it out first, then ask a specific, well\-framed question.
* **Ownership Mindset (in training):** You care about getting things right. When you make a mistake, you flag it early rather than hoping it goes unnoticed, and you're open to feedback on how to fix it.
* **Clear Communication:** You can explain a problem or update in simple, organised terms, whether in writing or in a call.
* **Balance of Logic \& Creativity:** You're comfortable with structured, detail\-oriented work (like software configuration) and also have an eye for what looks good and on\-brand.
* **No Prior Experience Required:** Freshers and students who are within a few months of graduating are welcome to apply. Prior internship, project, or freelance experience in operations, client service, or digital marketing is a plus but not required.

**What Success Looks Like** 

* You can independently handle routine, well\-documented parts of client onboarding and account management, escalating only the non\-standard cases.
* You've built working fluency in our core platforms and processes, and can navigate most day\-to\-day questions without step\-by\-step help.
* You're contributing real, usable work to client accounts, asset collection, quality checks, and first\-draft scoping that a Specialist reviews before it goes out.
* You've shown enough judgment and reliability that leadership can start handing you more autonomous ownership.

How to Apply: Please submit your résumé along with a brief description of a time you had to learn a new tool, process, or system quickly (in a class, project, or previous job) and how you went about it

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

description:
Job Description
**Accountant**


**Location: New Delhi**


**Reporting To: Senior Accountant**

  

  

**About Glimmer Technologies**


**Glimmer Technologies is an enterprise AI company operating at the intersection of AI depth and real\-world workflows. We build multimodal AI solutions designed to help enterprises interpret complexity, unblock decisions, and systematically upgrade how they operate. Our platform spans Document and Decision Intelligence, Workflow and Journey AI, Policy and Knowledge Systems, Voice and Conversational AI, and Analytical Automation, all engineered to embed intelligence directly into the enterprise operating layer, not just sit on top of it. We are at a critical inflection point, building a category\-defining company for leaders who want to shape the foundation, not just manage it.**

  

  

**Position Overview**


**The Junior Accountant will be the backbone of Glimmer's day\-to\-day transactional finance operations. Reporting to the Senior Accountant, this role is responsible for ensuring that the steady volume of vendor invoices, employee expenses, customer payments, and bank entries are recorded accurately, completely, and without delay. This is a high\-accountability role in a lean, fast\-moving team, where precision in the details directly enables the entire finance function to operate effectively.**

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**Accounts Payable Processing**


**–Handle data entry for vendor invoices, ensuring accurate coding to the correct cost centre, account, and period.**


**–Process employee expense claims in line with company policy and ensure proper approvals are in place.**


**–Coordinate with the Senior Accountant to ensure vendor payments are disbursed on time.**


**–Maintain an organised vendor payment tracker and flag overdue or pending items proactively.**


**Accounts Receivable Support**


**–Assist in the preparation and issuance of customer invoices as directed by the Senior Accountant.**


**–Support accounts receivable follow\-ups, including tracking outstanding payments and maintaining AR records.**


**–Ensure all customer receipts are recorded accurately and matched to the correct invoices.**


**Bank Reconciliation \& Record\-Keeping**


**–Perform daily bank reconciliations, ensuring all transactions are matched and discrepancies are flagged promptly.**


**–Maintain accurate and well\-organised accounting records, files, and supporting documentation.**


**–Assist with general ledger entries and support the month\-end close process as directed.**


**Compliance Support**


**–Support the Senior Accountant in the preparation of data required for GST and TDS filings.**


**–Assist with documentation and record compilation for statutory audits and internal reviews.**


**–Ensure all financial documents are stored systematically and are audit\-ready at all times.**

  

  

**General Finance Support**


**–Assist with any ad hoc accounting and finance tasks as assigned by the Senior Accountant or Finance Controller.**


**–Proactively flag any errors, duplicates, or inconsistencies observed in transaction processing.**


**–Contribute to continuous improvement of transactional processes and filing systems.**

  

  

**Required Qualifications**


**Education**


**–M.Com or equivalent post\-graduate qualification in Commerce or Accounting, mandatory.**


**–B.Com with strong academic record also considered.**


**Experience Requirements**


**–1\-2\+ years of experience in an accounting or finance operations role.**


**–Freshers with strong academic credentials and relevant internship experience will be considered.**


**–Familiarity with accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or similar) is preferred.**


**Technical Competencies**


**–Working knowledge of basic accounting principles and the double\-entry system.**


**–Proficiency in Excel for data entry, reconciliation, and basic reporting.**


**–Familiarity with GST and TDS concepts is an advantage.**


**–Accuracy and speed in data entry with a strong eye for detail.**


**Leadership \& Soft Skills**


**–High degree of accuracy and a disciplined approach to record\-keeping.**


**–Proactive and dependable; takes ownership of assigned tasks and delivers on time.**


**–Willing to learn, ask questions, and take feedback constructively.**


**–Works well in a team environment and communicates clearly with supervisors.**

description:
Member of Technical Staff (Computer Vision Engineer) — Fast Code AI
   


**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India (onsite, Whitefield) ·
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time ·
 **Experience:** 
 0–1 years (freshers strongly encouraged)
 



  




 About Fast Code AI
 
 Fast Code AI is a \~50\-person AI company headquartered in Bengaluru, with FastCode AI Labs GmbH in Stuttgart. We take frontier AI into production for global enterprises in automotive, oil and gas, and machine manufacturing — including work that ships in real vehicles for companies like Mercedes\-Benz and Bosch. Founded by Dr. Arjun Jain (PhD, Max Planck Institute; formerly NYU, Yahoo!, Apple), we are bootstrapped, engineering\-led, and known as a talent factory: our engineers have gone on to Johns Hopkins, Chevening scholarships, and principal roles across the industry.
 



  




 The role
 
 You will build computer vision systems that look at the physical world — cars, factories, machines — and have to be right. This is production CV, not benchmark CV: cameras with real calibration problems, detection under real lighting, geometry that has to hold up when the vehicle moves. You will work directly with senior engineers and the founder, own real deliverables early, and see your work run in the field.
 



  




 What we screen for
 
 We do not require years of experience, publications, or a brand\-name university. We require fundamentals — real understanding, not keyword familiarity:
 


* **Camera models and parameters** 
 — intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion; what calibration actually does
* **Epipolar geometry** 
 — you can explain it from first principles and use it
* **Object detection** 
 — you know what your detector is doing under the hood, not just how to call it
* **Region proposal networks** 
 — architecture and reasoning, not just the acronym
* **Classical vision** 
 — e.g., why normalized cross\-correlation survives a lighting change, and when classical beats learned



  





 Strong Python and one of PyTorch/C\+\+; comfort with Linux and real datasets.
 



  




 Nice to have (genuinely optional)
 
 Multi\-view geometry or SLAM exposure · deployment experience (TensorRT, ONNX, edge devices) · open\-source contributions · anything you have built that sees the world.
 



  




 What you get
 * Frontier\-grade problems for real clients, shipped into the field — not proofs\-of\-concept
* Direct mentorship from senior engineers and the founder
* A culture where excellence is prized and rewarded — never at the cost of the person producing it
* The alumni track record speaks for itself: we grow people, including beyond us


- 

 How to apply
 
 Send a resume AND the thing we actually read first: a short note or link showing something you built — a repo, a project, a demo. We check GitHub before pedigree.
 



 Apply on LinkedIn or write to us with subject "Computer Vision — \[Your Name]" to manali\+cvfresh@fastcode.ai

title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
Here is a professional **Job Description (JD) for a Customer Relationship Manager (CRM)** that you can use for interviews or job postings.

Job Title

**Customer Relationship Manager (CRM)**

Job Summary

A Customer Relationship Manager is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with customers, ensuring customer satisfaction, resolving issues, and improving customer loyalty. The role focuses on understanding customer needs and providing excellent service while supporting business growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with customers.
* Respond to customer inquiries through phone, email, chat, or in\-person meetings.
* Resolve customer complaints promptly and professionally.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products or services.
* Follow up with customers to ensure satisfaction.
* Maintain accurate customer records in CRM software.
* Coordinate with sales, operations, and support teams to resolve customer concerns.
* Monitor customer feedback and suggest improvements.
* Achieve customer satisfaction and retention targets.
* Prepare customer reports and maintain documentation.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Active listening and problem\-solving abilities.
* Customer\-focused attitude.
* Time management and organizational skills.
* Ability to handle difficult situations calmly.
* Basic knowledge of CRM software (such as Salesforce, Zoho CRM, or HubSpot CRM).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline (MBA is an advantage).
* Freshers may be eligible for entry\-level positions; 1–3 years of customer service or relationship management experience is preferred for experienced roles.

Preferred Skills

* Negotiation and conflict resolution.
* Sales and cross\-selling knowledge.
* Data analysis and report preparation.
* Teamwork and collaboration.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score.
* Customer retention rate.
* Complaint resolution time.
* Response time to customer queries.
* Customer feedback ratings.

Typical Interview Questions

* Tell me about yourself.
* Why do you want to become a Customer Relationship Manager?
* How would you handle an angry customer?
* How do you build trust with customers?
* What would you do if a customer wanted to cancel a service?
* How do you prioritize multiple customer requests?
* What is the difference between customer service and customer relationship management?
* Have you used any CRM software?
* How do you deal with difficult customers?
* Why should we hire you?

For someone with your MBA in HR and as a fresher, this role can also help you develop strong communication, relationship management, conflict resolution, and client\-handling skills that are valuable in HR careers as well.

* Monitor progress and report daily activities to the Project Engineer.

* Monitor labour attendance, productivity, and discipline.
* Maintain daily labour attendance and manpower reports.
* Coordinate labour requirements with labour contractors.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower to avoid idle time.
* Brief labour teams on daily work targets and quality expectations.
* Monitor overtime and ensure proper approval procedures.
* Address labour grievances in coordination with the Project Engineer.
* Ensure labour welfare facilities are maintained at site.
* Verify labour bills and work quantities before certification.

* Raise material requisitions based on work progress.
* Verify delivered materials against purchase orders.
* Ensure proper storage and handling of construction materials.
* Reduce wastage through effective material control.
* Maintain material consumption records.

* Ensure work complies with approved drawings and specifications.
* Conduct regular quality inspections during execution.
* Identify defects and coordinate corrective actions.
* Assist in material inspections and testing.
* Maintain quality checklists and inspection records.

5\. Safety Management

* Ensure compliance with site safety regulations.
* Conduct toolbox talks with labour teams.
* Ensure proper use of PPE by all workers.
* Report unsafe conditions immediately.
* Assist in accident prevention and emergency response activities.

* Prepare daily progress reports.
* Maintain site diaries and work records.
* Record labour deployment and productivity.
* Assist in preparing measurement sheets and contractor bills.
* Maintain drawing revisions and site instructions.
* Update project progress photographs.

7\. Coordination

* Coordinate with architects, consultants, and MEP teams.
* Attend site meetings and implement instructions.
* Assist senior engineers in resolving technical issues.

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale.  Join us at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to global scientific discovery. As an Engineer I, Software, you'll develop solutions that help our customers make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. You'll contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of sophisticated software applications spanning laboratory instruments, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams including scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver high\-quality software that advances scientific research and laboratory efficiency.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

* Demonstrated curiosity, continuous learning mindset, and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, especially AI, data engineering, and intelligent automation.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross\-functional team environment while contributing innovative ideas and technical solutions.

title: HR / General Manager - India Operations
description:
Description
 



 About Opalus and OPAL
 



 Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI\-powered SaaS business operating platform for SMEs. OPAL places accounting at the core and connects finance, customers, people, projects, documents and workflow in one secure operating environment. We are establishing our software development team and office in Kochi, Kerala.
 



  





 The opportunity
 



 Lead the establishment, recruitment and day\-to\-day management of Opalus’s new India operation in Kochi. This is a senior people and business\-operations role for someone who can build the local organisation, create dependable office and HR processes, and help a multidisciplinary technology team perform at its best.
 



  





 What you’ll do
 


* Lead the establishment and day\-to\-day operation of the Opalus office in Kochi, including premises, workplace services, suppliers, equipment and local operating procedures.
* Build and run the recruitment process for the initial product and technology team, covering job advertising, sourcing partners, candidate screening, interview coordination, offers and onboarding.
* Partner with Opalus leadership and functional leads on workforce planning, role priorities, hiring schedules and team capacity.
* Own practical people operations across the employee life cycle, including onboarding, employee records, attendance and leave processes, performance cycles, learning, engagement and offboarding.
* Manage, support and organise the Kochi team, setting clear expectations and creating a professional, accountable and collaborative workplace culture.
* Coordinate payroll, benefits, employment documentation and statutory\-compliance activities with the company’s appointed professional advisers and service providers.
* Manage local operating budgets, procurement, vendor relationships, contracts, office assets and management reporting.
* Oversee technology assets, user access, joiner–mover–leaver processes and basic cybersecurity hygiene in coordination with the technical leadership team.
* Maintain clear operational policies, risk and issue registers, management information and escalation processes.
* Act as the principal operational link between the Kochi team, Opalus leadership and relevant external advisers or suppliers.



  





 Company description
 



 Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI\-powered SaaS business operating platform for small and medium\-sized businesses. With accounting at its core, OPAL is designed to connect finance, banking, customers, people, recruitment, projects, documents, workflow and reporting in one secure operating environment. A permissioned AI layer is being designed across the connected business record to help users understand information, prepare work and take controlled action with appropriate approvals and audit trails.
 



 The company has completed a high\-fidelity working prototype and is building the production\-grade platform for an initial Australian release. Opalus is now establishing a software development office and multidisciplinary product team in Kochi, Kerala, to help take OPAL through engineering, testing, release and ongoing product development.
 



  





 Requirements
 



  





 What you bring
 


* At least 10 years of progressive experience across human resources, talent acquisition, people operations or general management, including substantial responsibility within an HR function.
* Demonstrated, hands\-on responsibility within an HR or recruitment function for hiring software engineers and other technology professionals, including product, QA, DevOps and related roles.
* Experience reviewing technology CVs, conducting initial candidate assessments, coordinating technical interviews, managing offers and completing onboarding.
* Proven ability to establish or substantially improve an office, operating function or growing team in India.
* Strong people\-management capability, sound judgement and confidence handling performance, employee\-relations and workplace matters.
* Working knowledge of Indian employment practices, payroll administration, employee records and statutory\-compliance coordination.
* High digital fluency and confidence using recruitment, HR, collaboration, productivity, project\-management and reporting systems.
* Ability to manage budgets, vendors, facilities, procurement and multiple operational priorities with disciplined follow\-through.
* Excellent written and spoken English, strong stakeholder communication and the ability to work effectively with an international leadership team.
* An established professional network in Kochi or the wider Kerala technology and recruitment market.
* Experience setting up a new office or scaling a team from an early stage.
* Experience working with cross\-border teams, outsourced professional advisers and senior technical leaders.



  





 Preferred experience
 


* Experience in a SaaS, software product, FinTech, technology\-services or other technology\-led organisation.



  





 Location requirement
 



 This position is based in Kochi, Kerala, India. Applicants must already be based in Kochi or be willing to relocate to Kochi.

title: Assistant Manager- Employee Relations & HR
description:
**Overview**
 To ensure effective employee relations, statutory compliance, contract labour management, and workforce planning while supporting uninterrupted plant operations. The role is responsible for managing industrial relations, statutory compliance, contractor governance, procurement processes related to HR services, and recruitment and administration of apprentices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Employee \& Industrial Relations
* Maintain harmonious employee and industrial relations across the plant.
* Coordinate with employee representatives, committees, and stakeholders.
* Support grievance handling, disciplinary proceedings, and domestic enquiries.
* Assist in negotiations related to settlements, policy implementation, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with Standing Orders, company policies, and labour laws.
* Statutory Compliance
* Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, Apprentices Act, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, Industrial Relations Code, Occupational Safety, Health \& Working Conditions Code, and other applicable labour laws.
* Coordinate statutory inspections and maintain compliance records.
* Prepare and submit statutory returns, notices, and reports within prescribed timelines.
* Ensure timely renewal of statutory licences and registrations.
* Support internal and external compliance audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Contract Labour Management
* Manage end\-to\-end contract labour operations and ensure statutory compliance by contractors.
* Verify contractor licences, labour deployment, wage payments, PF, ESI, bonus, and other statutory benefits.
* Conduct periodic contractor compliance audits.
* Coordinate contractor onboarding, documentation, and performance reviews.
* Ensure adherence to company safety and compliance standards.
* Purchase Requisition (PR) \& Purchase Order (PO) Management
* Raise Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for HR and employee welfare\-related services.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Finance for timely issuance of Purchase Orders (POs).
* Track service delivery, invoice processing, and payment status.
* Monitor HR\-related expenditure within approved budgets.
* Maintain procurement documentation and vendor records.
* NAPS Recruitment \& Apprentice Management
* Plan and execute manpower hiring under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS).
* Coordinate with apprenticeship agencies, ITIs, and training partners.
* Complete apprentice registration on the apprenticeship portal and maintain documentation.
* Ensure onboarding, attendance, stipend processing, and statutory compliance for apprentices.
* Coordinate assessments, certifications, and apprentice engagement activities.
* Manpower Planning \& Recruitment
* Support recruitment of shop\-floor manpower, trainees, apprentices, and contract employees.
* Coordinate interviews, selection, onboarding, and joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment MIS and manpower dashboards.
* Work with department heads to meet approved manpower requirements.
* Vendor \& Service Management
* Coordinate with manpower suppliers and HR service vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed service levels.
* Ensure timely invoice verification and payment processing.
* Support vendor evaluation and renewal activities.
* HR Operations \& MIS
* Prepare monthly HR reports and dashboards related to manpower, contract labour, apprentices, compliance, and recruitment.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Support HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive process standardization and digitization of HR activities.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* MBA/MSW in Human Resources, Personnel Management, or Labour Welfare.
* Degree in Law or Labour Laws (preferred).


**Experience**
* 5–10 years of experience in Employee Relations/Industrial Relations within a manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of labour laws, contract labour management, statutory compliance, and apprenticeship administration.
* Experience in handling HR procurement processes (PR/PO), manpower planning, and vendor management.
* Exposure to ERP/SAP systems and HRMS applications is preferred.

**Why you should join the SmartBear crew:**

 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The Welfare Officer in a coal mine is a statutory position that is responsible for fostering harmonious relations between management and employees, addressing grievances, and promoting a conducive working environment. They oversee welfare activities, assist in leave management, and implement measures to enhance the standard of living and well\-being of the workers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Welfare Officer \- Coal Mining**
**Employee Relations And Grievance Handling**
 Establish and maintain communication channels between management and employees to ensure harmonious relations.
   

  

 Address and bring to management's attention both individual and collective grievances for prompt resolution.
   

  

 Promote productive efficiency and better working conditions by helping employees adjust to their work environment.

 Guide and support these committees in their initiatives and activities.
   

  

 Encourage employee participation in welfare and safety programs to enhance overall well\-being.

 Guide workers on the application process for leave and manage authorized absences effectively.
   

  

 Ensure workers are informed about their leave privileges and assist in addressing any related concerns.

 Advise management on welfare provisions such as housing, food, social and recreational facilities, sanitation, and education for employees' children.
   

  

 Supervise welfare activities, including the education and training of employees, to ensure they meet statutory and organizational standards.
   

  

 Suggest and implement measures to improve the living standards and overall well\-being of workers.
   

  

**Reporting And Compliance**
 Maintain records of day\-to\-day welfare activities and interventions.
   

  

 Prepare and submit an annual summary report of welfare activities to the Chief Inspector through the mine manager.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with all statutory requirements related to employee welfare and support continuous improvement in welfare practices.

description:
**Working with Us**
 Challenging. Meaningful. Life\-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high\-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.
   

  

 Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more careers.bms.com/working\-with\-us.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for an early‑career Analytics Engineer to help develop trusted, analytics‑ready data products that enable commercial reporting, business insights, and decision support. In this role, you will transform raw and curated data into well‑modeled datasets, metrics, and semantic assets that are easy for analysts and business users to consume. You will apply data modeling, SQL transformation, data quality, documentation, and governance practices while partnering closely with engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders to ensure data products are accurate, secure, reusable, and aligned to business needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and support analytics\-ready data products, curated datasets, and reusable transformation assets within a modern lakehouse environment to enable commercial reporting, self\-service analytics, and business insights.
* Translate business and analytics requirements into clear data specifications, dimensional models, metrics definitions, and dataset readiness criteria aligned to internal modeling and delivery standards.
* Develop and maintain scalable SQL\- and Python\-based transformation logic that integrates structured and semi\-structured pharma datasets such as claims, patient, sales, payer, HUB, and specialty pharmacy data.
* Apply internally developed accelerators, reusable code patterns, templates, and engineering guardrails to improve development speed, consistency, quality, and maintainability across data products.
* Create analytics\-friendly models, including fact and dimension tables, cross\-domain joins, slowly changing dimensions, and business\-rule\-driven metrics that support dashboard, reporting, and advanced analytics consumption.
* Implement standardized data quality checks, reconciliation logic, validation routines, and anomaly detection controls to ensure datasets are accurate, complete, consistent, and trusted by downstream users.
* Document data products, metric definitions, lineage, assumptions, reusable components, and known limitations in accordance with internal documentation and governance standards.
* Partner with data engineers, analysts, BI developers, and business stakeholders to support dashboard/reporting use cases, drive adoption of published data products, and continuously improve reusable delivery standards.
* Apply data governance standards, access controls, and compliant handling practices for sensitive and regulated data, including PII/PHI awareness.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong proficiency in SQL for analytics transformations, data modeling, validation, and performance tuning.
* Working knowledge of Python for data preparation, validation, automation, and analytical workflows.
* Experience developing analytics\-ready datasets using dimensional modeling concepts such as facts, dimensions, grains, keys, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT patterns, lakehouse concepts, and medallion architecture including bronze, silver, and gold/refined layers.
* Hands\-on familiarity with Databricks notebooks, jobs/workflows, Delta Lake concepts, and curated data product development.
* Understanding of semantic layer concepts, metric definitions, and how curated datasets support BI, dashboards, and self\-service analytics.
* Experience with data quality practices including profiling, cleansing, standardization, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and issue triage.
* Working knowledge of governance and secure data handling practices including documentation, lineage, access controls, and PII/PHI awareness.
* Familiarity with BI/visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI and the data structures required for effective reporting consumption.
* Understanding of engineering practices such as Git/version control, code reviews, modular development, and basic CI/CD concepts.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business conversations.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics/Mathematics, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering, or related roles building curated datasets, data models, and analytics\-ready assets.
* Experience transforming large\-scale structured and semi\-structured datasets using SQL and Python, with attention to data quality, business logic, performance, and maintainability.
* Preferred experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, and refined/gold\-layer data product development.
* Preferred experience working with commercial pharma datasets such as claims, sales, payer, patient, HUB, or specialty pharmacy data and understanding common identifiers, metrics, and integration challenges.
* Preferred experience in Medical Evidence Generation and the Medical data domain, including familiarity with evidence planning, scientific data assets, medical insights, publications, field medical activity, or related medical affairs datasets.
* Preferred exposure to BI/reporting use cases, semantic layer design, metric standardization, or dashboard\-ready data modeling.

title: Data Engineer
description:
At Rockstar Games, we create world\-class entertainment experiences.
   

  

 Become part of a team working on some of the most rewarding, large\-scale creative projects to be found in any entertainment medium \- all within an inclusive, highly motivated environment where you can learn and collaborate with some of the most talented people in the industry.
   

  

 Rockstar is seeking a Data Engineer to join our online services team, building an innovative game analytics platform and tools to better understand our players and enhance their experience across our titles.
   

  

 This is a full\-time, in\-office position based in Rockstar’s large game development studio in Bangalore, India.
   

  

**What We Do**
* The Rockstar Games Data Engineering team provides insights and actionable results to a wide variety of teams across the organization in support of their decision making.
* We work with petabyte\-scale data in Azure and Databricks, building both real\-time and batch pipelines that power analytics, machine learning, and player experience improvements.


**Responsibilities**
* Design and build real\-time and batch data pipelines in Azure Databricks using Spark, Airflow, and modern orchestration and build tools.
* Drive engineering excellence by implementing robust testing practices (unit, integration), code review standards, and CI/CD automation.
* Implement automated data quality frameworks and validation of pipelines.
* Build observability systems to monitor data integrity, drift, and system health. Troubleshoot complex data infrastructure and pipeline issues.
* Design analytics\-ready datasets that power business intelligence and operational reporting.
* Partner with diverse stakeholders (including Data Scientists, Analysts, and ML Engineers) to define use cases and build robust data products.
* Translate large datasets into actionable insights for leadership and product teams.
* Contribute to the evaluation and adoption of modern data platforms and distributed computing frameworks, assist in building proof\-of\-concept solutions, and support efforts to improve platform scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years experience in building data pipelines, distributed systems, or large\-scale data platforms on major clouds (Azure preferred).
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, testing strategies (unit, integration) code review practices, system design thinking.
* Experience with big data frameworks such as Spark or Databricks.
* Experience using Python for maintainable, testable data engineering and Spark or Databricks for large scale processing.
* Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow.
* Experience with streaming technologies, notably Kafka, in distributed environments.
* Proven work handling high volume structured and unstructured data (logs, telemetry, text) at scale.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP data services and building cloud native data architectures.


**PLUSES**
 Please note that these are desirable skills and are not required to apply for the position.
   

  

* Databricks platform experience (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows).
* Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with Snowflake, Cassandra, or other modern data platforms.
* Experience building, maintaining, or scaling ML infrastructure.
* Experience with CI/CD and deployment tools (TeamCity, Octopus) and Artifact Repositories (JFrog, Proget).
* Experience with Terraform.
* Gaming industry experience or passion for games.
