title: Data Scientist
description:
**(Junior level role \| 1–3 years' experience)** 




  





**About the firm** 




 January Capital is an established venture capital manager headquartered in Singapore. At January Capital, we seek to invest in technology businesses that will power growth in the Asia\-Pacific region over the coming decades. We're inspired by those individuals who are willing to dedicate themselves to solving some of the region's biggest challenges and challenge the status quo. Today, we are proud to have partnered with more than 60 exceptional companies, including Tazapay, Great Question, Skedulo, GO1, Akulaku, Shopback, Marqo and aCommerce. We manage more than US$450 million of assets on behalf of our investors, who comprise leading institutions, foundations, family offices and individuals.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Data is at the core of everything we do at January Capital. We are building a continuously updating world model of ambitious people and the companies they create—a temporal graph that spans careers, not just current roles. The core thesis is that people are more persistent and predictive than the companies they found. By tracking individuals across their full arc to date, we surface signal earlier than any reactive competitor. There are a multitude of data points across Asia Pacific, and this role will help synthesise those signals and extract incremental value from the data.
 



  





 As a Junior Data Scientist, you'll join the Data Science \& ML squad, turning the raw signal flowing through the graph (people moves, company events and funding activity) into analysis the investment team can act on. This is a hands\-on, analysis\-heavy role. You won't own model architecture on day one, but you'll be doing real work against real data from week one: exploring datasets, validating pipeline output, building features, and helping quantify what actually predicts a good investment.
 



  





 Working closely with the Data Engineer, product managers and the investment team,
 



 you'll contribute across three key areas:
 



  





**Investment intelligence \& analysis** 
 – Analyse people, company and signal data across the graph to identify what correlates with a strong investment outcome. Build and iterate on features that feed scoring and signal models, and help test hypotheses about which signals—such as career moves, hiring velocity, product launches and funding events—predict the "moment of maximum signal."
 



  





**Data quality \& pipeline support** 
 – Validate data quality coming out of ingestion pipelines, working closely with the Data Engineer. Write ad hoc SQL and Python analysis to answer investment\-team questions about coverage, freshness and signal recall, and help maintain internal dashboards for pipeline health and model performance.
 



  





**Cross\-functional collaboration** 
 – Work with the investment team and product managers across the firm, and present interesting findings back to the investment team clearly, without hiding behind jargon.
 



  





 You'll receive direct mentorship from veteran engineers and investors in this space, as well as exposure to how a top\-tier early\-stage VC fund evaluates companies and people. You'll have real ownership of analysis that feeds decisions the investment team makes every week while working on a proprietary temporal graph product. The role offers a competitive salary and equity in a product built to become a standalone company.
 



  





**What we are looking for:** 




**Required** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in data science or analytics (strong internships count).
* Strong SQL and Python (Pandas, scikit\-learn or similar).
* Solid grounding in statistics—comfortable reasoning about sample size, bias, and correlation vs. causation.
* Comfortable working with messy, real\-world data: entity resolution issues, missing values, duplicate records.
* Genuine curiosity about company and people data, and how it connects to venture investing—prior VC experience favourable.



**Nice to have** 



* Exposure to graph data structures or network analysis.
* Familiarity with private markets or startup ecosystems.
* Experience working in a small, fast\-moving startup environment.

title: Full Stack Data Scientist I/II
description:
Job Description
 



  





**FULLSTACK DATA SCIENTIST I/II** 




***Location: Rabat, Morocco (preferred) or Dakar, Senegal (preferred); open to other IDinsight office locations (Nairobi, Kenya; New Delhi, India; Manila, Philippines; Lusaka, Zambia)***




  





 IDinsight is hiring full\-time full\-stack junior data scientists (1 to 4 years of relevant experience) to grow our machine learning, LLM, and broader data science capabilities. In this role, the data scientist will work with project teams and clients to use advanced analytics to drive social impact. You may build models that help locate out\-of\-school children, LLM\-powered co\-pilot for teachers or healthworkers, or agentic solutions to help citizens access benefits. We are a social\-impact\-oriented organization, so we can guarantee incredibly meaningful work tackling some of the world’s most complex international development challenges.
 



  





**Grow as a data scientist while doing meaningful work** 




 We are a growing and entrepreneurial data science team trying to solve some of the world’s most pressing challenges. Our work combines product development and consulting\- we design and build contextually relevant tools as well as support partners in using them effectively on the ground.
 



 This role offers end\-to\-end involvement: from problem scoping and tool design, to deployment, and providing hands\-on support to our partners. You will get to work closely with our partners, as well as with a multidisciplinary team\- including economists, social sector experts, and public health specialists\- to create practical, impactful tools that solve some of the world's most urgent problems.
 



 Learning is a key part of being a data scientist. 10% of your time would be dedicated to learning new skills and side projects of your choice. You’ll have strong mentorship to guide your data science career, and you’ll make interesting and valuable connections.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking candidates with a strong background in Python and core data science skills, and a passion for building solutions to difficult social problems. Ideal candidates should possess the ability to work independently to solve complex challenges related to both human and technology and be able to quickly learn new tools, technologies, or programming languages as needed.
 



 As a junior data scientist, the day\-to\-day work may include:
 


* Working with clients to understand their needs: Understanding their current processes and pain points and identifying which of these can be framed as a tractable data science problem.
* Designing, testing, and improving various algorithms: From OOTB sci\-kit\-learn algorithms to bespoke ones.
* Working with Large Language Models to build reliable and safe AI solutions
* Working on various parts of the solutions \- frontend, backend, deployment, etc.
* Using satellite imagery and geospatial tools to identify suitable land parcels for solar parks
* Using solvers to optimize resource allocation for a health or education system.
* Synthesising, visualizing, and communicating results: Dashboards, plots, interactive viz, presentations and reports
* Write blog posts or present on lesson learned



  





**Required Technical Qualifications** 



* Proficiency working in Python is required. Please do not apply if you are not proficient in standard data science packages in Python (numpy, pandas, scikit learn, etc.). The application will ask you specific questions about your Python abilities.
* Proficiency in understanding and coding standard supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms and components of the data science pipeline \- data cleaning, feature selection, cross\-validation, parameter tuning, etc.
* Experience building solutions using Large Language Model
* Sound foundations in statistics and probability.
* Working knowledge of SQL
* B.S./B.S.E. degree in Applied Math, Data Science, Computer Science, Physics, or a Similar Technical Field



  





**Other required qualifications:** 



* Proven ability to work alone and with teams in a dynamic, multicultural environment.
* Passion for improving lives through evidence\-informed policy.
* Strong oral and written communication skills in English. Fluency in languages spoken in countries where IDinsight works is a plus.
* Strong values aligned with IDinsight’s stated values.
* Ability and interest in sharing knowledge, mentoring others, presenting work and reviewing the work of others.
* Deeply passionate about global development and improving lives in disadvantaged populations.
* Open\-minded self\-starter who will thrive while tackling new, unusual and unpredictable challenges.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 The most competitive applicants will also have experience in one or more of the following:
 


* Experience living and working in developing country settings.
* Experience working on optimization and unsupervised learning problems.
* Experience working with SQL, custom APIs and AWS products like RDS, EC2, and Lambda.
* Experience working with GIS software such as QGIS.
* Experience working with satellite imagery / remote sensing data.
* Professional proficiency in French (written and spoken) is a plus.



  





**Locations** 




 This position is preferably based in Rabat, Morocco or Dakar, Senegal. Candidates based in other IDinsight office locations (including Nairobi, Kenya; New Delhi, India; Manila, Philippines; Lusaka, Zambia) may also be considered for a strong match. Preference will be given to those with pre\-existing work authorization in these countries; however, IDinsight will seek work permits where possible for exceptional candidates.
 



  





**Compensation** 




 Compensation is commensurate with relevant experience and background and is competitive within the social sector. Please note that, as a non\-profit, we are unable to provide compensation similar to leading technology firms.
 



  





**Start Dates** 




 The start date of this position is flexible, although there is the potential to start almost immediately. We expect a minimum one\-year commitment, with regular professional development conversations and potential for a long\-term career at IDinsight.
 



  





**How to apply** 




 Please click the "Apply for this job online" button at the top right. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis

title: Algorithm Engineer (SDE 1)
description:
About Bytebeam
 
 Bytebeam builds connected\-vehicle and device infrastructure spanning telemetry, diagnostics, analytics, device management, and applications. Our teams work with real\-world vehicle data that is noisy, incomplete, high\-volume, and operationally important.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are looking for an early\-career Algorithm Engineer to join our vehicle\-intelligence team. You will work with senior algorithm and systems engineers to turn telemetry into useful, testable signals for fleet operations and vehicle health. The role covers data exploration, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, and the production hand\-off needed to make an algorithm reliable outside a notebook.
 


 What You'll Do
 * Explore time\-series telemetry from vehicles and connected devices to understand behavior, failure modes, and data quality.
* Build and evaluate algorithms for areas such as anomaly detection, trip and driving insights, health indicators, and predictive maintenance.
* Create reproducible datasets, baselines, evaluation metrics, and error\-analysis workflows.
* Work with systems and backend engineers to integrate algorithms into streaming or batch production paths.
* Investigate mismatches between model expectations and field behavior, then improve features, thresholds, or data collection.
* Document assumptions and limitations so product and engineering teams can use outputs responsibly.
* Contribute clean, tested code and participate in design and code reviews.


 Must\-Have Skills
 * 0\-2 years of relevant industry or project experience.
* Strong Python fundamentals and practical experience with NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn, or similar tools.
* A sound base in probability, statistics, data structures, and algorithmic problem solving.
* Experience analysing time\-series or other noisy real\-world datasets.
* Ability to explain how an approach was evaluated, where it fails, and what evidence would improve it.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical work.


 Good\-to\-Have
 * Exposure to CAN, OBD\-II, J1939, GPS, IMU, battery, or other automotive/IoT signals.
* Experience with PyTorch, signal processing, anomaly detection, forecasting, or predictive\-maintenance problems.
* Familiarity with SQL, Linux, Git, data pipelines, or deploying Python services.
* Evidence of strong work through internships, research, open\-source contributions, or substantial personal projects.


 What Success Looks Like
 * You can independently take a well\-scoped vehicle\-data problem from exploration to a reviewed baseline, quantify its usefulness and failure cases, and collaborate with production engineers to ship and monitor the result.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Join us as a “Data Scientist” at Barclays, where you will apply advanced analytics, statistics and machine learning to solve complex business challenges. You will work with large\-scale datasets to develop predictive models, create CI/CD pipelines, generate actionable insights and support strategic decision\-making across customers, risk and commercial domains.
   

  

 The Decision Intelligence team at Barclays drives strategic business impact through advanced analytics, machine learning and data science. The team develops predictive models, forecasting solutions and analytical frameworks that help shape customer, risk and commercial decisions across the business. Working with large and complex datasets, Data Scientists translate business challenges into scalable analytical solutions, uncover actionable insights and support data\-driven decision making. The team collaborates closely with business, technology and risk stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that enhance customer outcomes, improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk management and create measurable commercial value.
   

  

 To be successful as a "Data Scientist" you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
* Experience developing and deploying machine learning models, including supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
* Strong understanding of statistical analysis, experimentation and predictive modelling.
* Experience working with large, complex and diverse datasets, including data preparation, feature engineering and model optimisation.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based analytics platforms such as AWS or equivalent cloud environments.
* Experience with Spark/PySpark and distributed data processing frameworks is advantageous.
* Knowledge of software engineering and MLOps principles, including version control, testing and deployment practices.


**Desirable Skills/ Good To Have**
* Ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and guide decision\-making using data.
* Commercial mindset with a focus on delivering measurable business impact and customer value.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, curiosity and a continuous learning mindset.
* We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical and technical capabilities with the ability to work collaboratively across teams. The ideal candidate is passionate about solving real\-world business problems, enjoys working with data at scale, and is motivated by delivering outcomes that create meaningful value for customers and the organization.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as strong analytical and technical capabilities , change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 Location \- Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To use innovative data analytics and machine learning techniques to extract valuable insights from the bank's data reserves, leveraging these insights to inform strategic decision\-making, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation across the organisation.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Data Scientist to design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions that solve business problems. The role involves working across the ML lifecycle — from data analysis and feature engineering to model development, evaluation, and productionisation.
 



  





**Experience Range:** 




 2 – 4 Years of professional experience
 



**Department / Domain:** 




 Data Science \& Analytics (Fintech / Risk / Fraud preferred)
 



**Employment Type:** 




 Full\-Time / Permanent
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 ● Develop and deploy machine learning models for classification, regression, and other predictive analytics use cases.
 



 ● Apply strong understanding of machine learning algorithms including Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting models (XGBoost), Ensemble techniques, and Neural networks / deep learning approaches where applicable.
 



 ● Perform feature engineering, including data preprocessing, encoding, missing value treatment, feature transformations, and creation of meaningful business features.
 



 ● Analyse large datasets to identify patterns, generate insights, and build data\-driven solutions. ● Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics such as AUC, Precision\-Recall, F1, KS, Gini, and PSI.
 



 ● Handle real\-world ML challenges including class imbalance, model calibration, data leakage, and model performance monitoring.
 



 ● Build scalable and production\-ready ML solutions and collaborate with engineering teams for deployment.
 



 ● Document models, including objectives, data inputs, performance metrics, and limitations. ● Stay updated with advancements in machine learning and apply relevant techniques to business problems.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 ● Experience building, improving, and independently scaling machine learning models. ● Strong foundation in machine learning concepts, statistical frameworks, and model optimization. ● Hands\-on mastery of Python (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn) and SQL databases. ● Advanced feature engineering capabilities, data preprocessing, and experience handling real\-world datasets (including class imbalances and complex workflows).
 



 ● Deep familiarity with structural model evaluation metrics, workflows, and execution strategies. ● Exposure to deep learning configurations, sequence models, or transfer learning approaches. ● Ability to build production\-ready ML models, collaborate with engineering teams, and translate complex business problems into effective ML solutions.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 ● Experience working in fintech, lending, risk, fraud, or other data\-intensive domains. ● Experience with model deployment, monitoring, and ML systems. ● Familiarity with research papers and emerging machine learning techniques.

 **Data Scientist** 
 to join our fast\-paced Fintech product team. You will leverage statistical analysis, machine learning, and potentially Generative AI to build impactful solutions that drive business outcomes, such as risk modeling, fraud detection, and predictive analytics.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role where you will take responsibility for projects from initial problem scoping and data discovery through feature engineering, model building, validation, and final deployment into production systems. You will work closely with data engineers and analytics engineers to ensure the reliability of data pipelines feeding your ML workflows.  Key ResponsibilitiesEnd\-to\-End Model Development
   

  

* Model Building: Design and develop sophisticated machine learning models for predictive analytics, fraud detection, and decisioning systems within the fintech domain.
* Production Deployment: Take full ownership of deploying models into production environments, ensuring they are scalable, robust, and deliver measurable business value.
* Performance Monitoring: Implement continuous learning systems for model evaluation, data refresh, and retraining to maintain high predictive accuracy in production.


 Data Pipeline \& Infrastructure Integration
   

  

* Collaboration: Partner with Data Engineers to source, clean, validate, and integrate data pipelines that feed into ML workflows.

* Data Governance: Ensure all data handling and processing complies with internal standards and external financial regulations (e.g., DPDP 2023\), maintaining strict data privacy.

+ NITs: (e.g., Trichy, Surathkal, Warangal, Rourkela).
+ IIITs: (e.g., Hyderabad, Bangalore, Delhi).

* Machine Learning: Solid grounding in ML fundamentals, statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, and experience with frameworks like Scikit\-Learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Latest Tech Stack: Experience with modern data science environments (e.g., Jupyter, DSW), cloud platforms (AWS preferred), and MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).
* Bonus (Not Mandatory): Familiarity with integrating LLMs or Generative AI workflows (LangChain, OpenAI APIs) into production environments.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive Salary: Up to ₹30,00,000 LPA, based on interview performance and specific skill sets.
* Impactful Work: The opportunity to build core models that directly impact risk management and business revenue.
* Work Environment: Full\-time, Work\-from\-Office setup in our modern Bangalore or Gurgaon locations to foster tight collaboration.

description:
**Job title** 
 : AI Solution Developer, Associate
   

  

* Location: Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

 As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 The AI Solution Developer, Associate helps build, integrate, and support AI agents that act within Opella’s Manufacturing \& Supply (M\&S) core systems — Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Quality Management Systems (QMS), and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP). Working alongside senior AI Engineers, you turn proven ideas into working agents that execute tasks — not just advise — across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, early\-career role at the heart of the MS.AI Factory, designed for a developer who wants to grow into a full Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE). You will learn by building — shipping real components into live workflows under the guidance of experienced developers, and steadily taking on more end\-to\-end ownership as your skills grow.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Build \& Support Agents: Develop, test, and maintain components of AI agents and workflows that act within MES, QMS, and ERP, under the guidance of senior developers.
* Integration Support: Help connect agents to enterprise systems (SAP, MES, QMS, LIMS) through APIs and MCP\-based integrations, following established, safe, and auditable patterns.
* Hands\-on Development: Write clean, tested Python code; contribute to RAG workflows, prompts, and agent logic, applying good software engineering practice.
* Testing \& Quality: Support validation, human\-in\-the\-loop checks, and documentation so agent actions are reliable, GxP\-aware, and trustworthy.
* Deployment \& Monitoring: Assist in deploying agents to production and monitoring their performance, flagging issues and helping resolve them.
* Collaboration: Work closely with senior developers, data teams, and business users — embedded with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality stakeholders in an FDE model.
* Continuous Learning: Grow expertise in agentic AI, GenAI frameworks, and M\&S processes, progressively taking on more independent, end\-to\-end delivery.


**About You**
**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Software \& AI Foundations: Solid programming fundamentals in Python, with an understanding of coding standards, version control (Git), and testing.
* GenAI Exposure: Familiarity with LLMs and generative AI concepts (prompting, RAG, agents), through coursework, internships, projects, or early professional experience.
* Integration Awareness: Interest in and some exposure to APIs and connecting software to other systems; willingness to learn MES / QMS / ERP (SAP) environments.
* Data \& Cloud Basics: Working knowledge of SQL and data handling; exposure to a cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) is a plus.
* Problem Solving: Ability to break problems down, debug, and deliver working solutions with support.
* Experience: 1–3 years of hands\-on development experience, including internships and personal or academic projects. Strong recent graduates with demonstrable AI projects are encouraged to apply.
* Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.


**Soft \& Behavioral Skills**
* Challenger Mindset: Curious and proactive, eager to question how things are done and try new approaches.
* All In, Together: Collaborative team player who learns from others and contributes openly across business and technical teams.
* Outcome\-Obsessed: Focused on shipping working solutions and delivering tangible value, not just prototypes.
* Courageous: Willing to take ownership of tasks, ask questions, and learn quickly from feedback and mistakes.
* Radically Simple: Strives to keep solutions clear and simple, and communicates progress and blockers openly.


 Why us?
   

  

 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

**Job Summary**
 Use analytical and quantitative methods to understand, predict, and enhance supply chain processes. Responsible for analyzing performance, identifying problems, and developing recommendations to improve the organization's Supply Chain.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Provide analytical support to one or more functional areas Use common processes tools, and information systems to enable supply chain analysis. Ensure data integrity of all analytics and reports. Analyze and interpret Key Performance Indicators to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Participate in six sigma and supply chain improvement projects Use existing business systems to provide analytics and reporting that are capable and repeatable.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Optimizes work processes \- Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
   

  

 Materials Planning System Utilization \- Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long\-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day\-to\-day operations.
   

  

 Plan for Every Part (PFEP) \- Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.
   

  

 Analysis and Troubleshooting \- Extracts, transforms, models, interprets, and presents planning data with the goal of mining useful information, troubleshooting, suggesting conclusions, and supporting value creating decision making.
   

  

 Inventory Management and Optimization \- Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end\-to\-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.
   

  

 Material Planning \- Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.
   

  

 Materials KPI Management \- Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end\-customer impact; strategically balances trade\-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

 College, university, or equivalent degree required.

 Minimal to intermediate level of experience required.

**About HabotConnect FZCO** 




  






 Habot Connect is a Dubai\-based, bootstrapped, 100% remote working company building a digital platform that connects parents with Learning Support Assistants (LSA) for children with learning difficulties . We operate in a high\-ownership, accountability\-driven remote culture where quality, precision, and structural clarity come before speed.
 




  





**About the Role** 




  






 Are you logical, detail\-oriented, and obsessed with flawless software execution? As our Junior Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst, you will serve as the crucial bridge between business requirements and software development .
 




  






 Your core mandate is to deconstruct Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Wireframes, and User Stories into explicit, testable criteria before code is released to production . You will collaborate daily with Software Developers, Team Leaders (TLs), and Operations teams to identify software risks early, execute manual test suites, log structured defects, and enforce strict Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) standards .
 




  





**Primary Responsibilities** 




  




* Requirement Deconstruction: Review and interpret Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Wireframes, and User Stories to validate that acceptance criteria are clear and complete .
* Test Case Creation \& Execution: Write comprehensive manual test cases covering Functional Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, Smoke Testing, and Boundary Value Analysis (BVA).
* Defect Lifecycle Management: Execute manual test plans, log structured bug reports with step\-by\-step Steps To Reproduce (STR), assign severity ratings, and verify defect resolutions.
* Cross\-Browser \& Device Verification: Validate User Interface (UI) responsiveness and User Experience (UX) across desktop browsers (Google Chrome, Apple Safari) and mobile viewports.
* Database Data Integrity: Execute basic Structured Query Language (SQL) queries to verify backend data updates against frontend inputs.
* Cross\-Functional Risk Mitigation: Communicate actively with Software Developers, Team Leaders (TLs), and clients to clarify ambiguities and prevent high\-impact production issues.



  





**Core Competencies** 




  





**Technical Skills / Tools:** 




  




* Manual Test Case Writing (Structuring detailed test steps using Boundary Value Analysis \[BVA] and Equivalence Partitioning \[EP]).
* Defect Tracking Tools (Logging and tracking bugs in Google Workspace or Microsoft Excel).
* Requirement Mapping (Mapping Business Requirement Documents \[BRDs] to test coverage matrices).
* Database Querying (Running basic Structured Query Language \[SQL] SELECT statements for data integrity checks).
* Cross\-Browser Testing (Validating User Interface \[UI] consistency on Google Chrome, Apple Safari, and Mobile Viewports).
* Life Cycle Frameworks (Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle \[SDLC] and Software Testing Life Cycle \[STLC]).



  





**Soft Skills:** 



* Meticulous attention to detail (spotting edge\-case flaws and silent logic errors),
* Clear technical communication, and extreme structural discipline
* Structured cross\-departmental communication
* Continuous learning mindset.



  





**Onboarding \& Success Path** 




  






 Selected candidates must successfully complete a mandatory structured onboarding and training program. Engagement and progress during onboarding are closely monitored and form part of the probation evaluation. Failure to complete required training or demonstrate sufficient involvement may result in the offer being withdrawn.
 




  





**What This Role Is NOT** 




  




* This is NOT an automated coding, Selenium, or Python test script engineering role .
* This is NOT a Software Developer or Systems Architecture position .
* This is NOT an unstructured, ad\-hoc, open\-ended decision\-making role without documented test plans



  





**Application Process** 




  






 Interested candidates are invited to apply. As part of our evaluation process, you will be required to complete a short Hiring Project to give a realistic preview of the daily analytical work expected of candidates, allowing both parties to determine mutual fit before making an offer.

description:
**Quality Assurance Engineer I (QAE1\)**
 WeDoGood
   

  

* Bangalore (In\-office)
* 0–2 years experience


**About WeDoGood**
 WeDoGood is an early\-stage startup working in the social impact space. Our flagship product is a Skilled Mentoring platform that connects beneficiaries across India with mentors who can guide them. We're a small, high\-velocity team of 5 engineers building on the latest web and AI technologies, and we care deeply about shipping products that genuinely improve people's lives.
   

  

 We're now hiring our
 **first Quality Assurance Engineer** 
 . This is a foundational role: you'll define what quality looks like at WeDoGood and own it end to end.
   

  

**The role**
 As our first QAE, you'll be the person who makes sure what we ship actually works. You'll take complex, ambiguous features, break them down into a clear test plan, execute it thoroughly, and find the bugs before our users do. You'll work directly alongside our engineers, embedded in the product from design through release.
   

  

 This role is heavy on hands\-on, manual testing, with room to grow into test automation and AI\-assisted QA as you build our quality foundation. If you're curious, love breaking things, and want to shape how a young company thinks about quality, you'll thrive here.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Understand a complex feature or problem deeply, then design a clear, thorough test plan that covers the happy paths, edge cases, and everything that could realistically go wrong.
* Execute test plans rigorously — functional, exploratory, regression, cross\-browser, and cross\-device — and find bugs that matter.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and partner with engineers to get issues fixed fast.
* Own release quality: be the gatekeeper who gives confidence that what we ship to production meets a high bar.
* Explore and experiment with QA tools, including AI\-assisted testing, to make our process faster and more effective over time.

* Strong grasp of QA fundamentals: test case design, edge\-case thinking, bug lifecycle, and how web applications behave.
* A self\-learner who's comfortable picking up new tools and figuring things out independently.
* Clear written and verbal communication — you can document a bug so anyone can reproduce it.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup where you define the process rather than inherit it.


**Nice to have**
* Hands\-on exposure to test automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) or an eagerness to learn them.
* Familiarity with API testing (Postman or similar) and reading logs to debug issues.
* Experience using Claude or other AI tools to assist with testing, test\-case generation, or exploration — a strong plus.
* Basic understanding of how modern web and AI\-powered products are built.
* Interest in the social impact space.


**Why join us**
* Be the first QA hire and set the quality standard for the entire company.
* Work closely with a small, senior engineering team on products built with the latest web and AI tech.
* High ownership, fast learning, and real impact on a product that helps people.
* Build something that matters, in the social impact space.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title: DevOps Engineer (AI \& Automation)** 




  





**Location: Noida** 




  





**Experience: Min 2\+ Years** 




  





**Department: Engineering / Infrastructure \& Platform** 




  





**Role Overview** 




**We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own our core DevOps administration while leading the** 




**implementation of AI\-driven development workflows. In this role, you will manage** 




**repositories, establish automated CI/CD pipelines, and design autonomous coding, testing,** 




**and code\-review agents using technologies like Claude Code, Anthropic Agent SDK, and** 




**GitHub Copilot Workspace/Agents. You will bridge classical platform engineering with AI** 




**native software development lifecycles.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. DevOps Administration \& Repository Management** 




**• Repository Architecture: Design, enforce, and maintain repository branching strategies** 




**(e.g., Trunk\-Based, GitFlow, Feature\-Branching) and access governance across** 




**organizations.** 




**• CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Build, optimize, and secure multi\-environment** 




**deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps with caching** 




**and automated quality gates.** 




**• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform,** 




**Pulumi, or Bicep, ensuring zero\-drift environments.** 




**• DevSecOps Integration: Implement automated secret scanning (e.g., Gitleaks),** 




**dependency vulnerability checks (Trivy/Snyk), and SAST/DAST within CI steps.** 




**2\. AI Coding Agent Setup \& Branch Workflows** 




**• Coding Agent Deployment: Configure and orchestrate developer AI agents (e.g.,** 




**Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Cloud Agents, or custom agent frameworks) to perform** 




**autonomous task execution across different Git branches.** 




**• Repository Context \& Prompts: Author and maintain repository\-level context files** 




**(AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, custom system prompts, and MCP server integrations) to** 




**steer agents toward project conventions and architecture patterns.** 




**• Multi\-Branch Automation: Configure workflow triggers that allow AI agents to pick up** 




**issue tickets, work within dedicated feature/bugfix branches, and automatically draft** 




**PRs.** 














**3\. Automated Code Review \& Testing Agents** 




**• Code Review Agents: Integrate automated AI code\-review agents within pull request** 




**workflows to perform compliance checks, security audits, and style adherence reviews** 




**before human sign\-off.** 




**• Automated Testing \& QA Agents: Build autonomous testing pipelines where agents** 




**analyze diffs, generate missing unit/integration tests, triage test failures, and suggest** 




**fixes directly in CI.** 




**• Governance \& Safeguards: Establish strict safety guardrails, execution sandboxes, and** 




**human\-in\-the\-loop approvals for agent\-generated code.** 




**Technical Qualifications** 




**Must\-Have Experience** 




**• Core DevOps (2\+ Years): Hands\-on expertise in CI/CD pipeline building, Docker,** 




**Kubernetes, and IaC (Terraform/Bicep/CloudFormation).** 




**• Git Administration: Mastery of Git internals, branch protection rules, merge strategies,** 




**and repository permissions.** 




**• AI Coding Tools \& SDKs: Proven experience configuring or extending GitHub Copilot** 




**(Copilot Workspace, Agent Mode, Custom Instructions/Skills) or Claude (Claude Code** 




**CLI, Anthropic API/SDK, Model Context Protocol).** 




**• Automation Languages: High proficiency in Python, Bash, or TypeScript/Node.js for** 




**building custom hooks, bots, and API integrations.** 




  





**Nice\-to\-Have Experience** 




**• Experience building multi\-agent orchestrations (e.g., CrewAI, LangChain, or custom** 




**sub\-agents).** 




**• Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server setups to connect AI agents with** 




**internal tooling, databases, and monitoring systems.** 




**• Deep understanding of DevSecOps standards and cloud infrastructure cost** 




**optimization.** 









**Expected 90\-Day Deliverables** 




**Month 1: Audit existing repos and establish standardized CI/CD templates and branch** 




**protection rules across all development projects.** 




**Month 2: Deploy initial Claude / GitHub Copilot agent workflows for automated PR code** 




**reviews and unit test generation.** 




**Month 3: Fully operationalize an end\-to\-end agentic workflow where feature tickets can be** 




**assigned to branch\-specific coding agents to generate, test, and submit initial pull requests.**

title: DevOps Engineer

 Responsible for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) as well as the security posture of our cloud infrastructure, this role requires extensive knowledge of automation, infrastructure, and security tools such as Terraform, Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions/GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Prometheus/Grafana, and IAM/secrets management platforms. The DevOps Engineer is tasked with addressing the organization's toughest technical and security challenges and driving technical excellence at all levels. Collaborating with senior management, the DevOps Engineer supports the execution of the organization's vision while ensuring smooth, secure operations for applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of technology at both the server and development levels, proactively identify and fill operational and security gaps, and prevent application emergencies and security incidents before they occur.
   

  

**Growth Prospects**

* Fast Appraisal \- Despite Covid, we had appraisals in 6 months in Jan \& July 2020

 VP/Director40\-50 LPAManager/ Tech Lead25\-40 LPAAPM/SDE 214\-25 LPAAnalyst/SDE 17\-14 LPA

* Work on Best Tech Stack \- AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, GitLab, Terraform, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Ansible, EKS, GKE, MySQL, and MongoDB.
* Learn from Best Mentors with Cumulative 50\+ years of experience in Tech who previously worked in 4 unicorns
* Fast Career Growth with fast appraisals and fast salary increase
* Super passionate team with deep conviction which has stayed together during covid.
* Build world class tech products and leverage technology to drive growth globally!
* Very high ownership role in a fast\-paced environment
* Great Culture \-\> No hierarchy / politics nonsense guaranteed!


**Our Founding Team**
 The founding \& engineering team has worked in senior leadership roles at successful internet startups in India and Overseas
   

  

* Arun \- Cofounder, leads Product \& Growth Ex Cars24, TravelTriangle, TripFactory, IIM Bangalore
* Chirag \- Cofounder, leads Business Operations Ex Oyo, TravelTriangle, IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee
* Ashish \- Cofounder, leads Technology Ex CTO Cars24, CTO FabFurnish, Gaadi, Ex\-Entrepreneur
* Shrawan: Tech Leader, 17\+ yrs Tech exp, Ex CTO Millenium Entertainment, One Kosmos
* Akshat: Tech Owner, 14\+ yrs Tech exp, Ex Cars24, Worked in USA, Singapore
* Rajesh:Tech Owner, 11\+ yrs Tech exp, Ex Hike, Foodpanda


**Company Profile**
* You read the detailed company profilehere.
* To know more about us, have a look at a few videos on Youtube!


**Key Responsibilities**
 DevOps / Infrastructure
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available infrastructure on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar) to enable fast, safe, and repeatable deployments.
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
* Manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/self\-managed).
* Set up and maintain observability: logging, monitoring, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog, New Relic, or similar).
* Drive cost optimization, capacity planning, and infrastructure scaling initiatives.
* Own incident response for infrastructure/production issues, participate in on\-call rotations, conduct RCAs and blameless postmortems.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to reduce manual toil.


 SecOps / Security
   

  

* Own the security posture of cloud infrastructure, including IAM policies, network security, VPC/firewall configurations, and secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, etc.).
* Implement and monitor security controls across CI/CD (SAST/DAST, dependency \& container vulnerability scanning).
* Set up and manage SIEM/logging for security monitoring, threat detection, and alerting.
* Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration test coordination, and remediation tracking.
* Define and enforce security best practices: least\-privilege access, encryption at rest/in transit, key rotation policies.
* Drive compliance initiatives (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, GDPR as applicable) and support audits.
* Build and maintain security runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation.
* Respond to security incidents, including triage, containment, root cause analysis, and post\-incident hardening.


**What We Are Looking For**
**Must have technical skills \-**
* Proficiency in cloud services (AWS or Google Cloud Platform) and containerization tools like Kubernetes and Docker.
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Linux OS
* Scripting (Shell/Bash/Python)
* Database management (MySQL, MongoDB).
* Expertise with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Chef/Puppet/Ansible, Maven/Nexus, EKS, GKE) and configuration management tools like Ansible and Terraform.
* Deploy and maintain infrastructure using Redis, Elasticsearch, and RabbitMQ for scalable and high\-performance applications.
* Working understanding of core security concepts: IAM, network segmentation, encryption, vulnerability management, and threat modeling.
* Experience with monitoring/observability and log management tools.


**Check if you fit in the role\-**
**You Must\-**
* Have 2\-5 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Security Operations (or a combined role).
* Be experienced with building, deploying, and operating tech infrastructure and applications.
* Be skilled in making software updates and fixing issues in deployments.
* Have strong hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred; GCP/Azure acceptable).
* Have solid experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Have strong incident management and on\-call experience.


**You Can\-**
* Collaborate with different teams to improve and streamline DevOps and security processes.
* Bring strong troubleshooting skills for infrastructure, deployment, and security issues.
* Coordinate vulnerability assessments and penetration tests, and track remediation.
* Bring familiarity with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI\-DSS) as a strong plus.
* Bring prior experience in a fintech, travel\-tech, or high\-transaction\-volume product company as a plus.
* Communicate excellently and work cross\-functionally with engineering, product, and leadership.


**You Want to\-**
* Drive technical excellence, automation, and a strong security posture.
* Grow in a fast\-paced environment.


**This Role Is Not Ideal For Someone Who Is\-**
* Is not comfortable being available during odd hours / at night for support and incident response.
* Has not worked on multiple backend applications independently.
* Is not self\-motivated to keep up with the rapidly evolving DevOps and security ecosystem.
* Is not comfortable with long working hours.
* Is not comfortable working 5 days a week from the office in Delhi.


**The Recruitment Process**
* Aptitude Test: The first step of the recruitment process is a 30\-minute basic aptitude test.

**Important Points**
* Office Location\- Connaught Place, Delhi

**Looking forward to having you on board with us!**

description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions at scale.
   

  

 Designed as a long\-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
   

  

 This role is designed to develop future Cloud Operations Engineers. The successful candidate will begin by supporting AWS FinOps and cloud optimization initiatives, before progressively taking on ownership of cloud operations, automation, infrastructure management, platform engineering, and end\-to\-end incident resolution.
   

  

**How will you make an impact:**
* Responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operation, monitoring, maintenance, automation, and optimization of AWS cloud infrastructure and hybrid Windows/Linux environments. This includes troubleshooting issues, identifying root causes, and implementing timely resolutions to maintain system stability and performance.
* Also focus on AWS cost optimization (FinOps), cloud governance, resource utilization analysis, and cost reporting, while building foundational knowledge of cloud operations.
* As technical expertise develops, responsibilities will expand to include cloud operations support, incident troubleshooting and root cause analysis, automation, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), platform operations, and DevOps practices.
* The ideal candidate is passionate about cloud technologies, AWS, automation, Python development, infrastructure operations, troubleshooting complex systems, and continuous improvement.


**What you'll need (Required):**
* Bachelor's degree in engineering or technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Management System) Required with 2 to 4 years of work Experience.
* Experience with Cloud Infrastructure and Software solutions


**What else we look for:**
* Knowledge of AWS cloud services including EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, AWS Systems Manager, and Lambda etc.
* Python scripting and automation skills is must.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure\-as\-Code concepts using Terraform is must.
* Understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems is must.
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud operations concepts.
* Understanding in AWS cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
* Familiarity with GitHub, GitLab, and Git version control concepts.
* Understanding of Git branching strategies and collaborative development workflows.
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD.
* Familiarity configuration management and Ansible or Tanium.
* Basic understanding of container technologies and container scanning/security practices.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.
* Passion for automation, AI \& cloud technologies, and continuous learning.

 Full\-time
 



  





 At Applix, we're building the Manufacturing Operating System that powers the next generation of intelligent factories. We're looking for a hands\-on DevOps / Platform Engineer to own the engineering platform that enables developers and business technology teams to build, deploy, and operate secure, reliable software at scale.
 



  





 This is more than a traditional DevOps role. You'll serve as the technical bridge between central IT, software engineering, and business technology teams—translating enterprise requirements into scalable platform capabilities, automation, and self\-service infrastructure.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, build, and operate cloud, on\-premises, and hybrid infrastructure.
* Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and CloudFormation.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
* Administer Linux and Windows environments.
* Support Docker and Kubernetes\-based workloads.
* Implement secure identity, access management, networking, and secrets management.
* Build monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, disaster recovery, and operational automation.
* Partner with IT, engineering, and business teams to standardize platforms and improve developer productivity.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 5–10 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, Systems Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
* Strong Linux and Windows administration.
* Experience with Azure and hybrid infrastructure; AWS and/or GCP experience is a plus.
* Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.
* Docker and Kubernetes.

* Networking fundamentals including DNS, VPNs, routing, firewalls, and load balancing.

* Enterprise or multinational IT experience.

* Observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Datadog, or Azure Monitor.

title: Associate Site Reliability Engineer II
description:
Role Reasonability
   

  

 MetLife is seeking a
 **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)** 
 to ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of critical applications and platforms.
   

  

 The SRE Engineer will monitor production systems, respond to incidents, improve observability, maintain runbooks, and automate operational tasks. Working closely with engineering, cloud, and infrastructure teams, the role supports SRE practices, operational readiness, and service reliability through SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budget management.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Monitoring: Monitor service health, dashboards, alerts, and key reliability indicators for assigned applications and platforms.
* Incident Response: Respond to alerts, support bridge calls, gather evidence, execute runbooks, communicate status, and escalate when required.
* Observability Support: Create and maintain dashboards, log queries, telemetry checks, alert validation, and actionable monitoring signals.
* Runbook Management: Document operational procedures, update recovery steps, validate readiness with service owners, and support knowledge sharing.
* Automation: Create scripts for repetitive checks, data collection, remediation, operational reporting, and toil reduction.
* Problem Follow\-up: Support root cause analysis, postmortem documentation, and closure of assigned corrective/preventive action items.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify alert noise, toil, monitoring gaps, and preventive improvements for senior SRE review.
* SRE Alignment: Support adoption of SLOs, SLIs, SLAs, error budgets, operational readiness reviews, and production support standards.
* AI Readiness: Use or help improve AI\-assisted tools for anomaly detection, incident correlation, root cause hints, and operational knowledge retrieval.
* Collaboration: Work with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to align service performance with business goals.


**Skills And Experience**
* Foundations: Linux, networking fundamentals, application support, cloud fundamentals, production operations, and ITIL\-style incident/change processes.
* Scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent scripting for automation, diagnostics, evidence collection, and reporting.
* Tools: Git, CI/CD basics, ServiceNow or equivalent ticketing; exposure to Elastic/ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, APM, and Azure Monitor preferred.
* Cloud \& Containers: Azure services, Docker, Kubernetes, and hybrid cloud operations exposure; Terraform or infrastructure\-as\-code awareness preferred.
* Reliability: Basic understanding of SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, alerting, incident response, postmortems, and operational runbooks.
* AI / AIOps Readiness: Ability to use AI\-assisted investigation, anomaly detection, and correlation tools responsibly, with strong validation of evidence.
* Database: Hands\-on SQL skills for operational diagnostics, data validation, and service health checks.
* Execution: Disciplined follow\-through, evidence capture, documentation, escalation hygiene, and collaboration during incidents.
* Learning Mindset: Willingness to deepen skills in cloud, Kubernetes, observability, automation, resilience engineering, and secure operations.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 2\+ years in production support, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud operations, or software engineering.
* Experience supporting business\-critical systems and working in incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Ability to script and automate standard operational tasks using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Exposure to regulated enterprise, insurance, banking, or financial services environments preferred.
* Business proficiency in English; Japanese language skills are a plus.


**Preferred Exposure**
* Hybrid cloud platforms including on\-premises and Azure\-hosted services.
* Observability platforms such as ELK/Elastic, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, Azure Monitor, and Azure Application Insights.
* GitHub, Azure DevOps, pipelines, repositories, and operational change controls.
* Kubernetes\-based production services and containerized application support.
* SRE practices including operational readiness reviews, service health reviews, and toil reduction initiatives.

 As a Cyber Security Engineer at slice, you will play a key role in strengthening our Application and Product Security program by embedding security throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). You will work closely with engineering, product, and infrastructure teams to identify security risks early, conduct security assessments, and help build secure, scalable products that meet industry standards and compliance requirements.
 



 This role is ideal for someone passionate about offensive security, secure design, mobile and API security, and DevSecOps.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**Application Security** 



* Perform end\-to\-end Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web applications, APIs, Android, and iOS applications.
* Conduct Secure Design Reviews and identify potential security risks during the design phase.
* Perform Threat Modeling sessions for new applications, services, and major feature releases.
* Validate security controls and perform security re\-testing after vulnerabilities are remediated.
* Prepare detailed security assessment reports with clear remediation guidance and risk prioritization.



  





**Mobile \& API Security** 



* Perform static and dynamic security analysis of Android and iOS applications.
* Assess REST APIs and microservices for authentication, authorization, business logic, and data exposure vulnerabilities.
* Identify vulnerabilities such as:
* Broken Authentication
* Broken Authorization (BOLA/IDOR)
* Injection attacks
* Sensitive Data Exposure
* Business Logic flaws
* Security Misconfiguration
* Rate\-limit bypass
* SSRF, XXE, CSRF, XSS, and related web security issues



 .
 


* Provide secure coding recommendations and remediation guidance.
* Contribute to the implementation and improvement of SAST, DAST, SCA, Secret Scanning, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) security practices.
* Evaluate new technologies and architectures from a security perspective and recommend appropriate security controls.
* Develop scripts and automation to improve security testing and vulnerability management workflows.
* Contribute to internal security tools and automation initiatives.
* Assist in improving security processes, standards, and documentation.



  





**Collaboration \& Compliance** 



* Partner with developers, architects, product managers, and infrastructure teams to drive secure\-by\-design principles.
* Provide technical security guidance during feature development and product releases.
* Ensure applications and infrastructure comply with internal security requirements and applicable industry standards.



  





**What You'll Need** 



* 1–2 years of experience in Application Security, Product Security, or Cyber Security.
* Strong understanding of web application, API, Android, and iOS security concepts.
* Hands\-on experience performing penetration testing of web applications, APIs, and mobile applications.
* Hands\-on experience in identifying and assessing network security vulnerabilities and security misconfigurations.
* Good understanding of:
* OWASP Top 10
* OWASP API Security Top 10
* OWASP Mobile Application Security (MASVS/MSTG)
* Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms including OAuth2, JWT, OIDC, and session management.
* Good understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and secure coding practices.
* Familiarity with common security vulnerabilities and exploitation techniques.
* Experience writing technical security reports and communicating remediation recommendations.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience with Linux systems and networking fundamentals.
* Experience with scripting using Python, Bash, or similar languages for automation.



  





**Tools \& Technologies** 




 Experience with one or more of the following tools is preferred:
 


* Burp Suite
* MobSF
* Frida
* Objection
* Postman
* Nmap
* Subfinder
* Amass



  





**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with AWS security concepts.
* Experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, Secret Scanning, and IaC Security.
* Experience with cloud\-native application security.
* Participation in Bug Bounty programs or responsible disclosure programs.
* Contributions to open\-source security projects.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted security testing and automation.



  





**Preferred Certifications** 



* eJPT
* eWPT
* eMAPT
* PNPT
* OSCP (Good to Have)



  





**What We Look For** 



* Passion for offensive security and continuous learning.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Curiosity to understand how systems work and how they can be secured.
* Ability to communicate effectively with engineering and business stakeholders.
* A collaborative mindset and willingness to improve security processes across the organization.



  





**Life at slice** 




 Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding:
 


* Competitive salaries. Period.
* An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees \& their dependents. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise.
* Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule.
* Tailored vacation \& leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life.
* A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here.
* Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding.
* Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”

title: MDR Analyst
description:
Our Purpose
   

  

 At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
   

  

**About Us**
 SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI\-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real\-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
   

  

 Our teams are builders, problem\-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission\-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
   

  

**What Are We Looking For?**
 We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
   

  

 As a MDR Analyst you will be tasked with Joining our Vigilance organization, an elite force of cybersecurity experts delivering a Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service to our largest customers. You'll help drive a world\-class threat monitoring, hunting, and response service, playing an integral role in a 24x7 follow\-the\-sun global SOC.
   

  

 You will work closely with key points of contact (POCs) and customers to provide an additional layer of security and confidence — leveraging intelligence feeds, threat logs, and IOCs (Indicators of Compromise) to detect and respond to threats effectively.
   

  

 You'll also collaborate with our world\-class threat research team and various R\&D groups, helping to shape our product, keep customers more secure, and establish your presence within the broader cyber tech ecosystem.
   

  

 What will you do?
   

  

 Primary responsibilities include:
   

  

* Proactively monitor and review threats and suspicious events from customers participating in the service Investigate alerts, triage, deep dive, and come up with proper action items and remediation plans.
* Use multiple sources of data from the customer, our intelligence cloud, external threat feeds, etc.
* Perform proactive hunting for threat data, leveraging our deep visibility abilities and proprietary research cloud.
* Work with the customer to follow up on items that require additional investigation.
* Provide Incident follow\-up \& support
* Maintain excellent customer satisfaction through professional, proactive, and personal service
* Work closely with our research and development team
* Contribute to our knowledge base by creating malware analysis cookbooks and best practices


 What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
   

  

 Ideal candidates will have:
   

  

* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in a SOC or Incident Response (IR) team.
* Strong network and security knowledge is desired
* Professional and articulate with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Multi\-OS incident investigation experience: Windows, Mac \& Linux (mobile platforms \- an advantage)
* Experience with computer forensic investigations, malware analysis or threat hunting is a plus
* Ability to multitask and prioritize
* Automation and scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or SQL are preferred.
* Be able to work a fluid and dynamic schedule to cover hours and days outside of the normal work week


 Why SentinelOne?
   

  

 AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI\-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add\-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
   

  

 We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:
   

  

 Equity \& Rewards
   

  

* Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)


 Time Off \& Wellbeing
   

  

* Competitive leave benefits
* Gender\-neutral parental leave


 Insurance \& Financial Security
   

  

* Medical and insurance benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)


 Work Perks \& Flexibility
   

  

* Global home office allowance
* Internet allowance
* LinkedIn Learning license
* Social Connect program
* Food allowance (Bangalore office)
* Meal vouchers (Sodexo)


 Wellness \& Lifestyle
   

  

* Health \& wellness benefit


 SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 SentinelOne participates in the E\-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

 Customer \& Workforce Identity — Okta / Auth0

 Nice to Have

title: Security Pen tester
description:
If you are looking for a meaningful career where people work and act with passion, rethink the existing and always strive to find the best solution \- you have come to the right place. We develop future technologies to relentlessly make supply chains better.
   

  

 We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are building a dedicated
 **RED Team** 
 to strengthen the security of our SaaS platform. As a
 **Penetration Tester** 
 , you will conduct internal offensive security assessments across our web applications, APIs, cloud environments, and emerging AI/LLM\-based features. You will identify, exploit, and document vulnerabilities to help the organization stay ahead of modern adversaries.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on technical role for someone who enjoys breaking things ethically, understanding how they work under the hood, and working closely with engineering and security teams to drive remediation.
   

  

**What a Day In The Life Looks Like**
* Conduct in\-depth penetration tests on web applications, APIs, microservices, and internal SaaS components.
* Perform manual vulnerability discovery and exploitation following OWASP methodologies.
* Simulate adversarial attack scenarios and participate in RED Team exercises.
* Conduct cloud\-focused penetration tests and configuration reviews (AWS, OCI and Azure).
* Test LLM/AI features for prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage, model manipulation, and other emerging threats.
* Develop custom proof\-of\-concept exploits where applicable.
* Work closely with engineering and product teams to provide clear remediation guidance.


**Security Automation \& Tools**
* Use and customize security testing tools (Burp Suite, ZAP, Nmap, SQLMap, etc.).
* Develop scripts or small tools for automation or exploitation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).
* Effectively use AI tools (Microsoft Copilot, Claude etc.) to accelerate testing, generate payloads, summarize findings, and produce documentation.


**Documentation \& Reporting**
* Create clear, detailed technical reports with reproduction steps and exploit evidence.
* Present findings to technical and leadership teams.
* Contribute to threat models and risk assessments.


**What You Bring To The Team**
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on penetration testing.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10 and practical experience exploiting them in real\-world applications.
* Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs.
* Solid understanding of web technologies (HTML, JavaScript, SQL, authentication mechanisms, etc.).
* Proven experience performing manual exploitation (not just tool\-based scanning).
* Experience testing cloud\-hosted applications and infrastructure (AWS, OCI and Azure).
* Knowledge of modern authentication (OAuth, JWT, SSO, SAML).


**AI/LLM Security (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* Experience testing AI/LLM\-powered features.
* Knowledge of prompt injection, jailbreaks, RAG attacks, model extraction, data leakage vectors.


**Tools \& Methodologies**
* Proficiency with:
+ Burp Suite Pro
+ Nmap
+ Nikto
+ SQLMap
+ Postman/Insomnia
