title: Solution Sales Engineer- IIoT
description:
**About the Role** 
  
 



 Are you a passionate and dynamic graduate engineer looking to build an exciting career in sales and marketing within the fast\-growing world of Industrial IoT (IIoT) and Digitalization? If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you! We are looking for talented and energetic engineers to join our Sales \& Marketing team and become specialists in IIoT and digital transformation solution sales for IIoTNext. In this role, you will drive sales and business development activities for Consyst’s IIoTNext platform products and solutions, helping industries and infrastructure businesses connect, monitor, and optimize their operations. 
 



**The Opportunity** 
  
 



 You will be at the front line of our IIoTNext growth story. Working closely with our pre\-sales and marketing teams, you will generate new leads, reach out to prospects through cold calls and digital channels, and respond to customer enquiries and RFQs. You’ll have the exciting opportunity to conduct product demos and presentations – both virtual and face\-to\-face – where you will show customers how IIoTNext solutions solve their real\-world challenges in digitalization, remote monitoring, and data\-driven decision making. You will also support our digital marketing efforts to build the IIoTNext brand and reach customers in both local and overseas markets. 
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 


* Generate new leads and build a healthy sales pipeline for IIoTNext through proactive prospecting, cold calling, emails, and networking.
* Reach out to potential customers across local and overseas markets, identifying new opportunities in the IIoT and digitalization space.
* Conduct engaging product demonstrations and presentations – virtual and face\-to\-face – clearly showing how IIoTNext solutions meet each customer’s needs.
* Build strong and lasting relationships with key customers, including Partners, End Users and OEMs, and communicate effectively with key decision\-makers.
* Support the digital marketing team with content, campaigns, and follow\-ups to promote IIoTNext and attract new leads online.
* Assist in preparing and submitting proposals and quotations for each opportunity, showcasing the value of our IIoT solutions.
* Meet and exceed regular sales targets, continuously improving the sales pipeline through proactive lead generation and conversion efforts.
* Collaborate closely with the pre\-sales and backend support teams to tailor the right IIoT solution to each customer’s unique requirements.
* Maintain precise and up\-to\-date sales data, updating all relevant information into our CRM/ERP system.
* Work in tandem with the sales lead to implement effective sales and marketing strategies for both local and overseas markets.



**Professional Qualifications and Personal Attributes** 
  
 


* A bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, instrumentation, engineering is required.
* 0 – 1 year of experience in IIoT / Digitalization / Industrial Automation solution sales. Fresh graduates with a strong interest in technology sales are welcome to apply.
* A strong desire to build a career in sales, with the confidence to make cold calls and meet new customers.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills to clearly explain our IIoT solutions and conduct product demos.
* Comfortable using digital tools, social media, and online platforms to support marketing and outreach.
* Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is necessary to articulate ideas clearly and professionally. Knowledge of additional languages is an advantage for overseas sales.
* Willingness to engage with customers in both local and international markets.



  





**Location:** 
 Cochin (with a focus on both domestic and overseas sales) 
 



  





 At Consyst, we believe in nurturing talent and fostering a collaborative work environment that promotes growth and innovation. If you are ready to take the next step in your career and make a real impact in the exciting world of IIoT and Digitalization with IIoTNext, we encourage you to apply today!

title: Robotics Trainer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Edubull is a technology\-driven education company that transforms traditional learning into engaging, personalized experiences for students and educators. With decades of experience in tech, Edubull focuses on solving core challenges in the classroom rather than relying on one\-size\-fits\-all solutions. The company uses advanced AI to identify why learners struggle and equips teachers with practical tools to address those gaps. Edubull is committed to creating fair learning opportunities for every student while empowering teachers to achieve meaningful outcomes.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Robotics Trainer will deliver hands\-on training sessions in robotics and related technologies to learners at the Bantwal campus. This is a full\-time, on\-site role that involves planning and conducting practical workshops, demonstrations, and assessments using robotics systems and equipment. The trainer will design and update course materials, create learning modules, and ensure safe and effective use of robotic tools, including welding and industrial robots. Daily responsibilities include guiding learners through troubleshooting exercises, supervising preventive maintenance activities, and providing clear explanations of robotic concepts and applications. The Robotics Trainer will collaborate with other faculty, support continuous curriculum improvement, and help learners build confidence and job\-ready skills in robotics.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in robotics, including practical experience with industrial robots and basic robotic systems.
* Hands\-on skills in robotic welding and related automation processes.
* Ability to perform troubleshooting on robotic equipment and diagnose technical issues efficiently.
* Experience in preventive maintenance of robots, ensuring safe and reliable operation.
* Prior teaching, training, or mentoring experience in technical or vocational education is highly beneficial.
* Diploma or degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related engineering/technical discipline.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in simple terms.
* Comfort working on\-site in a lab or workshop environment and adhering to safety protocols.
* Ability to plan sessions, manage groups of learners, and maintain accurate training records.

 C\+\+ and Python for high\-performance engineering softwareExperience with Open Cascade, CGAL, Eigen, or similar geometry libraries is highly desirable

 years developing CAD/CAM software, toolpath generation software, CNC software, additive

 Industrial robotics

 Medical device manufacturing

 Orthotics and prosthetics

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Humyn Labs** 




 Humyn Labs builds the intelligence layer for physical\-world AI — systems that perceive, reason, and act in real environments. Our work sits at the intersection of egocentric video understanding, embodied AI, robotics perception, and voice\-driven interaction. We move fast, obsess over data quality, and ship at scale.
 



  





 Humyn Labs converts human action \- across sound, sight, movement, and touch \- into high\-quality multi\-modal data signals for physical AI. Operating across 20\+ countries in India, southeast Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East: the real\-world environments where physical AI deploys, not the labs where it is built.
 



  





 Our data isn't just collected; it's evaluated, defended, and production\-ready. Because before AI can be trusted, its training data must be.
 



  





**The Role** 




 When a prospective customer says "show me," you're the person who makes it real — fast. You partner with BD and sales to turn deal conversations into working proofs\-of\-concept: whatever one\-off tooling a deal needs to move forward. Your job is to compress a buyer's time\-to\-trust from weeks to days. Turnaround speed is the whole point of the role.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Build POCs against real client/BD asks.
* Spin up miscellaneous tools and scripts on demand to unblock a deal or prove a capability.
* Work directly off BD/sales input, scope quickly, and deliver fast — owning the work end\-to\-end without hand\-holding.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 1–3 years of experience as a strong generalist engineer who operates unsupervised.
* Demonstrated fast turnaround — a portfolio of shipped side projects, hackathon builds, or other concrete proof you go from idea to working thing quickly.
* Solid engineering fundamentals and the judgment to know when "good enough to demo" beats "perfect."
* Pragmatic about tooling: you pick the fastest path to a working POC and aren't dogmatic about the stack.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience with data/video tooling or building dashboards and viewers.
* Familiarity with backend engineering concepts.
* Frontend chops for quick, presentable demos.



  





**How we work** 



* Fast\-paced startup.
* High ownership, pragmatic decisions, and a strong bias toward shipping.
* Speed and resourcefulness win here.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
About IncrediPets
 



 IncrediPets is building India's pet\-care ecosystem \- a consumer app that connects pet parents to services, products, and care, backed by a partner network and a live operations stack. We instrument behavior end\-to\-end across our surfaces, which means the person in this role gets to make decisions with real data on day one, not guesses.
 



  





 Why this role exists
 



 We don't need someone to manage a backlog. We need someone who can change what users do \- turn a one\-time visitor into a daily habit, a lapsed user into a returning one, a passive account into an engaged pet parent. This is a behavior\-shaping role first and a feature\-shipping role second.
 



  





 What you'll own
 


* Engagement and habit loops: design and ship the mechanics (notifications, streaks, reminders, nudges, re\-engagement triggers) that turn occasional usage into routine.
* Retention and activation: own the activation funnel and the early\-lifecycle journey; find where users drop and close the gap.
* Behavioral experimentation: run A/B tests and structured experiments against clear metrics; let the data, not opinion, decide what ships.
* The metric, not just the feature: every project is tied to a behavioral or retention number you're accountable for moving.
* Cross\-functional drive: work directly with engineering, design, and data to take loops from idea to live, and with the founder on what matters most.



 What we're looking for (must\-have)
 


* 1\-3 years in a product role at a consumer app, growth team, or similar \- where you owned outcomes, not just specs.
* Real users behind your work: you've shipped to a live user base and can point to what you built and how many people it reached.
* Behavior shaping with evidence: you've deliberately changed user behavior \- retention, habit formation, engagement, activation \- and can show the before/after.
* Data fluency: comfortable defining metrics, reading funnels and cohorts, and reasoning from analytics (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA, or SQL\-level comfort).
* Experiment instinct: you think in hypotheses and tests, not opinions.



 Nice to have
 


* Worked on notifications, lifecycle messaging, gamification, or recommendation surfaces.
* Exposure to consumer marketplaces, services, or subscription products.
* Basic SQL or hands\-on experience with an experimentation/analytics tool.
* Interest in pets and pet care (you'll get the user, faster).



 How we'll evaluate
 


1. Screen: portfolio of behavioral wins (what you moved, by how much).
2. Case: a take\-home or live exercise on an engagement/retention problem.
3. Analytical depth: reasoning through metrics and an experiment design.
4. Founder round: fit, ownership, and how you think about users.



 What you get
 


* Direct line to the founder and real decision ownership from week one.
* A fully instrumented product \- your experiments are measurable, not theoretical.
* Compensation: up to INR 12 LPA fixed, set by demonstrated behavioral\-product track record.



 Location: Gurugram, Haryana (on\-site) \| Full\-time \| Reports to: Founder/CEO

title: Project Manager I-IBM Maximo
description:
**Role Description**
 Project Manager Description Description: Lead the planning, governance, and successful delivery of One Maximo deployments, enhancements, support initiatives, and other enterprise IT projects across global sites. The Project Manager is accountable for driving projects from initiation through completion by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing scope, schedule, budget, risks, and stakeholder expectations while ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and global standards. In addition to supporting the One Maximo program, this role will provide project management expertise across other strategic digital transformation, infrastructure, application, and operational excellence initiatives as business priorities evolve. This is an outcome\-driven role requiring ownership, leadership, and proactive execution rather than project coordination alone. Key Accountabilities Deliver One Maximo implementation, enhancement, and support projects successfully across global sites. Lead project governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure for multiple concurrent initiatives. Support delivery of enterprise IT and business transformation projects beyond the One Maximo program. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and quality expectations. Maintain visibility of project health through proactive management of risks, issues, dependencies, and changes. Drive stakeholder engagement, executive communication, and cross\-functional collaboration. Ensure successful transition from project delivery into operational support. Core Responsibilities Project Delivery Lead end\-to\-end delivery of One Maximo implementation, rollout, upgrade, support, and enhancement projects. Manage additional enterprise IT initiatives including application implementations, infrastructure projects, digital transformation, and process improvement programs as assigned. Develop integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, and resource plans. Coordinate activities across Business, IT, Infrastructure, Validation, Quality, Vendors, and Support teams. Balance competing priorities across multiple concurrent projects while ensuring successful delivery. Project Governance Establish and maintain effective project governance aligned with organizational PMO standards. Facilitate project kickoff meetings, governance reviews, steering committee meetings, and executive updates. Maintain RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) logs and ensure timely mitigation. Manage project financials including budgets, forecasts, resource utilization, and variance reporting. Ensure compliance with project management methodologies and organizational governance frameworks. One Maximo Program Support Coordinate deployment of new sites into the One Maximo platform. Ensure alignment with One Maximo Global Standards (OMX GSOPs). Support deployment readiness, cutover planning, hypercare, and operational transition. Partner with technical teams to ensure successful validation, data migration, testing, and user adoption. Monitor project progress and remove delivery obstacles proactively. Enterprise Project Support Support planning and execution of strategic enterprise initiatives outside the Maximo landscape. Manage projects involving business applications, infrastructure, cloud migration, system integrations, automation, and operational improvements. Apply consistent project management standards and governance across all assigned initiatives. Collaborate with business leaders to prioritize project portfolios and optimize resource allocation. Stakeholder Management Build trusted relationships with business leaders, IT teams, vendors, and global stakeholders. Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans clearly and proactively. Facilitate cross\-functional decision\-making and resolve delivery conflicts. Escalate critical issues appropriately while maintaining project momentum. Risk, Change \& Quality Management Identify, assess, and manage project risks throughout the project lifecycle. Control project scope through structured change management processes. Ensure quality deliverables and adherence to internal standards and regulatory requirements where applicable. Support audit readiness and project documentation compliance. Continuous Improvement Drive continuous improvement of project delivery methodologies, governance processes, and reporting standards. Capture lessons learned and implement best practices across future initiatives. Promote standardization, efficiency, and knowledge sharing across project teams. Support long\-term digital transformation and enterprise application strategies. Success Measures Success in this role will be measured through: Successful delivery of projects on time, within scope, budget, and quality expectations. Effective governance and executive reporting. Successful deployment and adoption of One Maximo across global sites. Strong stakeholder satisfaction and cross\-functional collaboration. Proactive management of project risks, issues, and dependencies. Smooth transition of projects into operational support. Delivery of strategic enterprise initiatives aligned with business priorities. Continuous improvement in project delivery performance and organizational maturity. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. 8\+ years of project management experience delivering enterprise IT projects. Experience managing IBM Maximo, Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), CMMS, or similar enterprise application implementations. Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects within global organizations. Experience working with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams. Strong understanding of project governance, budgeting, forecasting, and risk management. Experience working in regulated environments (Life Sciences, Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical, or similar) is preferred. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting enterprise digital transformation initiatives. Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITIL) principles. Experience with Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid project delivery methodologies. Familiarity with cloud technologies, enterprise applications, and systems integration projects. Portfolio or PMO experience is an advantage. Key Skills Project Management End\-to\-End Project Delivery Program Coordination Project Planning \& Scheduling Scope Management Budget \& Cost Control Resource Planning Risk \& Issue Management Change Management Project Governance Executive Reporting Functional IBM Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Asset Lifecycle Management Digital Transformation Enterprise Applications IT Operations Business Process Improvement Leadership Stakeholder Management Cross\-functional Team Leadership Executive Communication Strategic Planning Negotiation \& Conflict Resolution Decision Making Problem Solving Tools IBM Maximo Microsoft Project Microsoft Planner Jira / Azure DevOps Smartsheet Microsoft Office 365 Power BI (Preferred) Working Model Embedded within global enterprise project teams supporting One Maximo and strategic business initiatives. Remote\-first with collaboration across global stakeholders and time zones. High autonomy with accountability for project outcomes. Flexibility to support additional enterprise projects based on business priorities. Occasional travel to project locations as required. title: Package Engineer-Project Management
description:
**Role Summary**
 Package Engineer supports the end\-to\-end execution of specific project packages—such as Boiler Structure, Pressure Parts, Non\-Pressure Parts, BOIs etc.—within a large\-scale EPC project. Reporting to the Package Manager, the role involves coordinating with engineering, procurement, construction, and quality teams to ensure timely availability of inputs and smooth package execution. The Package Engineer assists in tracking progress, resolving technical issues, and managing interfaces across functions. The role also includes preparing documentation, following up with vendors and subcontractors, and ensuring compliance with technical specifications, project standards, and safety requirements under the guidance of the Package Manager.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/ Accountabilities**
**Package Execution \& Coordination**
* Support the Package Manager in the execution of the assigned package (e.g., Boiler Structure, Non Pressure Parts, BOIs etc) as per project schedule, quality, and cost objectives.
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and site execution teams to ensure timely availability of drawings, materials, and technical inputs.
* Track progress of engineering deliverables, manufacturing clearances, dispatches, and site activities related to the package.
* Assist in identifying execution bottlenecks and escalate issues for resolution in a timely manner.
* Maintain and update package\-level tracking reports, dashboards, and documentation for review.
* Timely processing of vendor invoices for Customer billing \& vendor payment.


**Procurement \& Vendor Coordination**
* Follow up with vendors and suppliers for timely submission of engineering drawings, QAPs, and technical documents.
* Monitor manufacturing status and coordinate inspections, dispatch plans, and logistics with concerned functions.
* Support quality and logistics teams in organizing inspections and ensuring readiness for material movement to site.
* Track and report vendor performance against contractual milestones and technical compliance.


**Contract and Commercial Support**
* Assist in reviewing technical specifications and scope of work for the assigned package.
* Support the Package Manager in documenting changes, deviations, and claims for onward submission.
* Provide input for package billing, certification, and cost monitoring activities as required.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Liaise with client representatives, consultants, and site teams for obtaining necessary approvals and clearances.
* Coordinate technical discussions and queries with vendors and ensure timely resolution.
* Facilitate effective communication between internal teams and external stakeholders for package\-related matters.


**Quality, Safety \& Compliance**
* Ensure adherence to approved quality assurance plans and safety protocols during package execution.
* Support quality audits, inspections, and compliance checks at vendor works and construction site.
* Maintain proper documentation of inspections, NCRs, and corrective actions implemented.

title: Technical Project Manager III
description:

title: Project Scrum Master
description:
Facilitate core Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective) to help the team deliver committed outcomes each sprint.
   

  

 Coach the team on Agile/Scrum fundamentals and reinforce agreed working agreements, Definition of Ready, and Definition of Done.
   

  

 Partner with the Product Owner to support healthy backlog refinement, clear acceptance criteria, and a shared understanding of priorities.
   

  

 Remove or escalate impediments in a timely manner and help the team navigate blockers, risks, and dependencies with guidance from more senior Scrum Masters or leaders.
   

  

 Use Jira/Azure Boards (or similar tools) to maintain accurate boards, sprint metrics, and team transparency (e.g., sprint progress, throughput/velocity trends, and impediment logs).
   

  

 Promote collaboration across engineering, product, and partner functions to improve flow, quality, and predictability of delivery.
   

  

 Support continuous improvement by helping the team identify, prioritize, and track actions from retrospectives.
   

  

 Participate in PI planning and other SAFe ceremonies (as applicable) and help ensure team commitments and dependencies are communicated and managed.
   

  

**Skills And Qualifications**
 Core Scrum and Agile Expertise
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
   

  

 2\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master (or in a similar Agile delivery role) supporting technology delivery teams
   

  

 Scrum and/or SAFe certification (e.g., Scrum.org, SAFe) required
   

  

 Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and basic Lean/flow concepts; ability to apply practices pragmatically for the team
   

  

 Working proficiency with Jira and/or Azure Boards (or similar) to manage backlogs, boards, sprint metrics, and reporting
   

  

 Familiarity with Confluence (or similar) for documenting team working agreements, decisions, and process artifacts
   

  

 Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Understanding of how team delivery supports product goals and customer value
   

  

 Experience working with delivery teams and business partners across different time zones
   

  

 Ability to help the team translate priorities and acceptance criteria into actionable sprint work
   

  

 Customer mindset helps the team stay focused on outcomes, quality, and feedback loops

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job\-specific skillsets.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

**Essential Skills**
* Strong expertise in Agile/Scrum frameworks and ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Reviews, Retrospectives).
* Proven experience in delivery management, including release planning, dependency management, risk and issue tracking.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage Product Owners, Technology Leads, Business Teams, and Senior Management.
* Strong facilitation, conflict resolution, and leadership capabilities.
* Proficiency in Agile tools such as JIRA, Confluence.
* Experience in tracking and communicating Agile metrics (velocity, sprint predictability, burn\-down, cycle time).
* Ability to drive teams toward delivery commitments while removing impediments and managing escalations.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**
* Experience managing multiple Agile teams and working in scaled Agile environments (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS). Domain knowledge in Banking, Risk, Finance, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting, or Data Management. Demonstrated ability to lead Agile transformation and organizational change initiatives.
* Strong executive communication skills with experience presenting delivery status, risks, and KPIs to senior stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications such as CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist, PMI\-ACP, or PMP would be added benefit.


 This role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. **Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 The Lead Scrum Master is a key member of a development squad with a well\-defined software development life cycle process. The Lead Scrum Master applies a broad technical knowledge of the Agile methodology to manage the scrum process with geographically dispersed teams to deliver exceptional standards in product quality and timely, predictable delivery of projects. The Lead Scrum Master oversees cross functional coordination and communication, requirements traceability, release management, test case management, and defect tracking concerns to keep delivery on track.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Agile Knowledge and expertise
* Understands Agile and relevant frameworks (e.g., scrum) to maximize the success of the squad.
* Possess a comprehensive understanding of Agile tools, techniques, principles and values and apply this knowledge to the squad.
* Coach PO and squad to maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog with refined user stories.
* Successfully balance delivery timeframes and continuous iteration so that customer feedback is always incorporated.
* Participate in Scrum of Scrums sessions to ensure the Squad and the others in the Tribe are aligned on priorities, dependencies and timelines.
* Coaching and Facilitation
* Provide role (PO, QA, Dev, etc.) based coaching and proactively facilitate coaching session with the squad.
* Coach the squad to consider how squad/product vision affects other squads we regularly interact with.
* Create a safe environment for all ceremonies to encourage active participation from all squad members.
* Facilitate and mediate conflicts within the squad.
* Reporting
* Ensure accurate and transparent communications to stakeholders with concise metrics and updates on progress, risks, and impediments.
* Release Planning \& Supports Product Owner on release planning.
* Coordinate movement of code between Development, Testing, UAT and Production environments and a related planning, resourcing and scheduling activities.
* Project Management \& Project Planning
* Goal Setting \& Managing Job Schedules
* Coordinating Resources \& Managing and delivering projects to specification using a defined development process and delivering within budget and timeline
* Mind Set and Behavior
* Build meaningful relationships with squad members and resolve most issues leveraging your rapport and trust with squad members.
* Be an enthusiastic change agent and peer.
* Accept change and use it to drive continuous learning and process improvements within the squads.
* Continuously seek and act on feedback received to bring about positive changes. Servant Leadership
* Understand both the squad’s overall capacity and impediments that impact individual members of the squad. Work to create a team culture that values sustainable execution by not over\-committing.
* Coach the squad to provide input for squad level decision making to achieve a common goal.
* Identify and work to resolve mindset impediments as they arise.
* Coach squad with knowledge and expertise as well as encourage experimentation to support their journey towards self\-sufficiency.
* Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 6 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Experience in Agile Development, with Scrum Master (or similar) experience
* Previous software development lifecycle experience
* Scrum Master certification a plus

description:
**About VectorShift**
 VectorShift is a workflow automation platform. We are defining how enterprises and operators leverage LLMs to automate complex tasks.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 You will partner closely with our founders and engineering team to own the design function at VectorShift. This is a hybrid role for a versatile designer who loves variety: one day you might be solving a complex UX problem for our workflow builder, and the next you might be build chat experiences from our 100k\+ users.
   

  

 You aren’t just "making things pretty"—you are translating abstract AI logic into an intuitive, powerful interface that feels magical to use.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Product Experience (The Core)**
* Own the detailed UX/UI: Lead end\-to\-end design for VectorShift’s core features, including our no\-code pipeline builder, node logic, and data integrations.
* Simplify Complexity: Take complex technical concepts (variables, loops, LLM chains) and turn them into simple, drag\-and\-drop interfaces that non\-engineers can understand.
* Ship Real Software: Deliver high\-fidelity Figma mocks and prototypes that are ready for engineering. Work side\-by\-side with devs to ensure the final build matches the design specs.
* Building Delightful Experiences: build end user experiences that make the users come back over and over again


 Who You Are
   

  

* 1\+ Years Experience: You have a strong background in Product Design, ideally at a SaaS, DevTool, or Productivity startup.
* Portfolio that shows "Logic": You can share a portfolio that goes beyond pretty pictures. We want to see Case Studies that explain how you solved a difficult problem, from wireframe to final pixel.
* Figma Master: You are fast and efficient in Figma. You know how to use auto\-layout and components to keep files organized.
* Technical Aptitude: You don't need to code, but you understand how software is built. You can speak the language of engineers and understand constraints.
* Scrappy \& Fast: You are comfortable with the "mess" of a startup. You don't need a 30\-page brief to get started; you ask questions and iterate quickly.


 Why Join VectorShift
   

  

* High Ownership: You are not a cog in a machine. You are the design voice of the company.
* Category Creation: You are helping define the UI/UX for the emerging field of AI automation.
* Direct Impact: Your work will be shipped to thousands of users immediately. No red tape.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
**Start your engineering career on a system that genuinely matters.**
 PrismHR is the HR, payroll, and benefits platform used by employer\-services organizations across the United States, backed by Vensure Employer Solutions. As an Associate Software Engineer you will join the team building and supporting the client\-facing applications, working alongside product managers, designers, architects, QA and DevOps engineers, and engineering managers.
   

  

 The first months are deliberately weighted toward learning\~ building proficiency in our languages, tools, and patterns through training, pairing, and self\-study, with real support from senior engineers rather than a link to the documentation.
   

  

 From there you take on real work — writing, testing, debugging, and documenting application code as part of the delivery team; investigating and resolving technical issues including production questions escalated to engineering, which is one of the fastest ways to learn a large system; working with data through queries, analysis, and reporting to support decisions; researching technologies and bringing back a recommendation rather than a summary; and communicating progress and blockers clearly in team ceremonies. You will be given genuine ownership as you show readiness for it.
   

  

**You will need\~**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Strong analytical aptitude and solid computer science fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, databases
* Ability to write and debug code in at least one language, shown through coursework, internships, personal projects, or early professional work
* Strong communication, including explaining a concept clearly to someone who does not already understand it
* Genuine appetite for continuous learning, since the stack and the domain will both be new


**Nice to have\~** 
 internship or project experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, or Git; exposure to Agile teams; interest in payroll or HR technology; any experience debugging something you did not write.
   

  

**The schedule\~** 
 6\~00 PM \- 3\~00 AM IST, Monday to Friday, with the first four hours from the Noida office and the rest from home — no 3\~00 AM commute. Early in a career, overlap is how you learn fastest\~ same\-day code review, real\-time answers from the engineers who know the system, and a seat in design conversations rather than a summary afterward. Your mornings and afternoons are genuinely free.
   

  

**Being straightforward\~** 
 a night shift is a real adjustment, particularly as a first or second job. Think about it honestly before applying, and talk to us about it in the screen rather than after you start.
   

  

 Competitive compensation for the level, health coverage, structured onboarding and mentorship, learning support, and a defined progression path to Software Engineer. Apply now.
   

  

 \#VensureHRIndia
